author: Mada Masr
title: Organizations rally in support of Mada Masr, condemn ‘weaponization’ of media law against independent journalism
content:
Rallying in support of Mada Masr, statements of solidarity have emerged in recent days from domestic and international advocacy organizations, political figures and parties, journalists and media platforms, all expressing their backing for the independent journalistic website and for Editor-in-Chief Lina Attalah, following her referral to trial last week by prosecutors.


Though Mada Masr has been called in for questioning on an almost annual basis in relation to journalistic coverage, this is the first time prosecutors initiate a trial of this kind. Attalah is due to attend a misdemeanor court session in New Cairo on Tuesday on the charges of founding, managing and operating a website without a license.


During a gathering at the Journalists Syndicate on Saturday, several General Assembly members and independent journalists declared their support for Mada Masr and condemned what they described as an “assault on independent journalism,” referring to the escalation that began in September with the arrest of six journalists from the independent fact-checking platform Matsda2sh.


In the ensuing weeks, Attalah received a summons for investigation,

fielding

 six hours of questioning from the Supreme State Security Prosecution about her efforts to acquire a license for Mada Masr since 2018, the website’s operations, as well as questions concerning a recent report on protest actions taken by prisoners across the country and authorities’ response.


She was informed less than 24 hours after the investigation session that she has been referred to trial on charges of running an unlicensed website.


Following news of the trial referral, 119 human rights organizations and media institutions from around the world came together to condemn the “unprecedented attack on press freedom in Egypt,” in a Friday

statement

 calling for an end to the legal pursuit of Attalah and urging that Mada Masr be granted a license to operate following its multiple applications to media regulators.


They also called for Egypt’s authorities to halt the targeting of independent media outlets — including Matsda2sh — and to release all 26 journalists currently imprisoned in Egypt in relation to their work.


The list of signatories to the joint statement includes Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, the Committee to Protect Journalists, PEN International, the International Federation for Human Rights, the Robert F. Kennedy Human Rights Center and the Electronic Frontier Foundation.


Also among the signatories are the International Fact-Checking Network, the Center for International Policy, the Tahrir Institute for Middle East Policy and dozens more Arab and international media platforms.


The signatories stated that Attalah’s trial threatens the future of independent journalism, knowledge production and civil society in Egypt. They warned that the potential penalties — fines ranging from LE1 to LE3 million and possible orders for the website’s closure — could effectively end the operations of one of the last remaining independent media institutions in the country.


Individual expressions of support were also forthcoming from Democratic United States’ Senator Chris Van Hollen, who called the charges against Attalah “baseless,” and described the events from Matsda2sh’s arrest to Attalah’s pursuit as “the most severe crackdown on the press seen in years.”


Van Hollen, a member of the US Senate Committee on Foreign Relations, called for an end to the assault.


Amnesty International had already demanded on Wednesday an end to what it described as the persistent judicial harassment of Attalah and Mada Masr’s journalists, prior to the trial referral, with Yasmin Ahmed, the organization’s regional impact director, stating that targeting the editor-in-chief for the journalistic work produced by her team is “outrageous” and pointing to the fact that this is the sixth case brought against the outlet and its journalists in the span of six years.


The Committee to Protect Journalists’ regional director, Sara Qudah, likewise

described

 these recent actions as a coordinated assault on the press, condemning Attalah’s referral to trial “for operating a website without a license that Egyptian authorities have themselves refused to grant for years.”

author: Mag
title: „An euren Händen klebt Blut!“: Studentische Proteste gegen tödliche Korruption weiten sich in Serbien zu Streiks gegen die neoliberale Regierung aus
content:
Dossier


„

In Serbien finden derzeit die größten Straßenproteste seit Jahrzehnten statt. Der Anlass: Anfang November stürzte in der nordserbischen Stadt Novi Sad das Vordach des Bahnhofs ein. Bei dem Unglück kamen 15 Menschen ums Leben. Studierende organisieren seit dem Vorfall Proteste und fordern von der Regierung, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und den Fall aufzuklären. Die Demonstrierenden sehen die tief verwurzelte Korruption im Land als Ursache für den Einsturz. (…) Die Proteste weiteten sich über das ganze Land aus. Den Protesten haben sich Oppositionelle, Schüler und Schülerinnen, Professorinnen, Künstler und Bauern angeschlossen. Im Dezember wurde ein weiterer Skandal öffentlich, der das Vertrauen in die Regierung erschütterte: Die Menschenrechtsorganisation Amnesty International berichtete, dass die serbische Polizei und Geheimdienste die Handys von Aktivisten und Journalisten mit einer israelischen Spionagesoftware infiziert haben.

..“ Umfangreicher

Beitrag vom 26.12.2024 im Deutschlandfunk


 („Jugend vereint sich gegen Korruption“), siehe die weitere Entwicklung:


Noch kurz vor der Wahl in Serbien zeigt die studentisch und zivilgesellschaftlich organisierte Bewegung, dass sie unabhängig vom Wahlverlauf gewonnen hat…


„

Es stimmt, dass die Wahlen in #Serbien morgen weder frei noch fair sein werden, das autokratische Vučić-Regime über sehr viel Macht und Erfahrung verfügt, Wahlen zu manipulieren und die Wahrscheinlichkeit groß ist, dass am Wahltag die letzten Medien erstickt werden, die noch kritisch berichten. UND


Es stimmt auch, dass weltweit Menschen seit Tagen Videos in Social Media posten, in denen sie entschlossen erklären, wie weit und lange sie reisen werden bzw. müssen, um ihre Stimme für Rechtsstaatlichkeit und Demokratie abzugeben, um Menschen in Serbien zum Wählen zu motivieren. Das ist völlig neu.


Es stimmt auch, dass Menschen, die noch nie in ihrem Leben politisch involviert, engagiert waren, in den letzen Monaten Schulungen durchlaufen haben, um als Wahlbeobachter*innen an den abgelegensten Orten Serbiens zu sein. Es kursieren schon Videos, wie Betrugsversuche aufgedeckt, verhindert werden

…“

Thread von Dejan Mihajlović vom 24. Oktober 2026 unrolled aus bsky


 


Brennende Geduld


„

Am Sonntag wird in Serbien ein neues Parlament gewählt. Alltagsimpressionen von der Straße

…“

Artikel von Milorad Živojnov in der jungen Welt vom 24.10.2026

 


Vor Parlamentswahl in Serbien: Zehntausende Anhänger der Opposition auf Belgrads Straßen


„… Drei Tage vor der Parlamentswahl in Serbien haben zehntausende Anhänger der Opposition für ein Ende der Regierung von Präsident Aleksandar Vučić in dem Westbalkanstaat demonstriert. Die Anhänger der Studentenliste zogen am Donnerstagabend durch die Straßen von Belgrad und versammelten sich schließlich auf dem Salvija-Platz der Hauptstadt. Nach Angaben der unabhängigen Gruppe Archiv öffentlicher Versammlungen nahmen rund 150.000 Menschen an der Kundgebung teil. (…) Vučić war Ende September nach neun Jahren von seinem Amt als Präsident zurückgetreten und kandidiert nun für den Posten des Regierungschefs, den er bereits in den drei Jahren vor seiner Zeit als Präsident innehatte. Mit dem Rücktritt machte er den Weg für die Neuwahlen am Sonntag frei und entsprach damit einer Hauptforderung der studentischen Protestbewegung, die nach dem Einsturz eines Bahnhofsvordachs in der Stadt Novi Sad im November 2024 entstanden war. Bei den vor allem von Studierenden getragenen Protesten ging es anfangs vor allem um die Aufarbeitung des Unglücks, bei dem 16 Menschen ums Leben kamen. Später weiteten sich die Themen der Demonstrationen auf generelle Kritik an der Regierung und an der weitverbreiteten Korruption im Land aus. (…) Nach Angaben zivilgesellschaftlicher Gruppen war der Wahlkampf von Einschüchterungen, Festnahmen und dem Missbrauch öffentlicher Gelder geprägt. Verlässliche Prognosen zum Ausgang der Wahl liegen nicht vor. Der Politikwissenschaftler Dušan Vučićević von der Universität Belgrad sagte AFP, er rechne damit, dass die Studentenliste mehr als 40 Prozent der Stimmen gewinnen werde – dies wäre das beste Ergebnis einer Oppositionsgruppierung, seit die SNS 2012 an die Macht kam…“


Meldung vom 23. Oktober 2026 in der taz online

author: anred
title: De Stonewall a  la Argentina que gobierna Milei
content:
El ajuste, los discursos de odio y el debilitamiento de las políticas públicas ponen en tensión derechos conquistados por décadas de lucha. En este contexto mundial de vanzada de la ultraderecha, la organización de la Comunidad LGBTIQ+ vuelve a las calles el próximo 7 de noviembre para realizar la 35 Marcha del orgullo. «Cuando el odio avanza, el orgullo en las calles es resistencia».

Por Rocío Cisterna para ANRed 


Hay momentos históricos en los que luchar por existir deja de ser solamente una reivindicación y se convierte en una disputa política contra el orden establecido. Cuando el hambre, el ajuste, la discriminación, la persecución y la violencia institucional amenazan las condiciones de vida, los derechos conquistados dejan de parecer garantizados y las calles vuelven a ser escenario de resistencia.


La

rebelión de Stonewall

 fue uno de esos momentos. Hoy, en la Argentina gobernada por Javier Milei, su historia adquiere una renovada vigencia: cuando el Estado debilita las políticas de protección, desfinancia derechos y promueve discursos estigmatizantes, la resistencia se convierte en una necesidad colectiva.


Pero esta disputa no se limita a nuestras fronteras. También se inscribe en un escenario internacional marcado por el avance de las ultraderechas, las alianzas geopolíticas y las confrontaciones en torno a la libertad, la democracia, la soberanía y los derechos humanos.


Stonewall: cuando la resistencia rompió el silencio


En junio de 1969, las personas homosexuales, lesbianas, trans y otras identidades disidentes sufrían distintas formas de criminalización, hostigamiento y persecución en Estados Unidos. Las redadas policiales contra los bares frecuentados por estas comunidades formaban parte de un sistema que buscaba controlar los cuerpos, las identidades y los afectos que desafiaban la norma dominante.


La madrugada del 28 de junio, quienes estaban en el Stonewall Inn, en Greenwich Village, Nueva York, se negaron a someterse pasivamente a la violencia policial. El hartazgo frente a años de persecución se transformó en una rebelión que se extendió durante varias jornadas y se convirtió en un símbolo internacional de las luchas por la liberación sexual y los derechos de las diversidades.


Stonewall no fue solamente una revuelta contra una redada policial. Fue una ruptura con el silencio impuesto y con la idea de que las personas LGBTIQ+ debían aceptar la violencia como una condición inevitable de su existencia.


Su legado recuerda que los derechos no fueron concesiones generosas del poder, sino conquistas de quienes se organizaron y resistieron. Esa memoria sigue presente cada vez que una persona trans encuentra obstáculos para acceder a la salud, cuando se produce una situación de discriminación o cuando un gobierno pretende convertir el odio en sentido común.


Argentina: del avance de derechos al ajuste


Argentina construyó una historia de conquistas en materia de derechos humanos, diversidad y ampliación de derechos civiles. El Juicio a las Juntas, el Nunca Más, la Ley de Educación Sexual Integral (ESI), el matrimonio igualitario y la legalización de la interrupción voluntaria del embarazo forman parte de un recorrido colectivo que demuestra que las transformaciones sociales son posibles mediante la organización popular.


Ninguna de esas conquistas fue resultado de una concesión espontánea. Todas fueron producto de décadas de militancia, debate público y movilización. Por eso, tampoco pueden darse por garantizadas.


Desde la asunción de Javier Milei, las organizaciones feministas, transfeministas, LGBTIQ+ y de derechos humanos denuncian un escenario de retroceso, ajuste y debilitamiento de las políticas públicas. La eliminación del Ministerio de las Mujeres, Géneros y Diversidad y los recortes presupuestarios expresan un cambio en las prioridades del Estado nacional.


También preocupan el financiamiento y la implementación de la ESI, las políticas vinculadas con la interrupción voluntaria y legal del embarazo (IVE e ILE) y el acceso efectivo a la salud integral de las personas trans y no binarias.


No se trata de discusiones abstractas ni de diferencias meramente ideológicas. Se trata de recursos, profesionales, tratamientos, acompañamiento y prevención. Cuando las políticas públicas desaparecen o pierden capacidad de respuesta, las consecuencias recaen sobre vidas concretas y profundizan desigualdades que ya existen.


El ajuste no impacta de la misma manera en todos los sectores …

author: By John Malamatinas, Contributor
title: TikTok Revolt in France: A New Generation Takes To The Streets
content:
On October 17, France witnessed some of the most intense urban unrest in its recent history. Hundreds of thousands of people demonstrated across the country, while clashes with police, widespread looting, and burning barricades transformed the streets of numerous cities. Activists described the events to Unicorn Riot as among “the fiercest riots France has experienced since World War II.”


The protests were not confined to Paris. From Marseille and Lyon to Bordeaux, Limoges, and numerous smaller cities, demonstrators confronted police, occupied streets, and attacked commercial and government buildings.


The mobilization had begun weeks earlier. On September 7, a young TikToker called for a revival of the Yellow Vests movement, which had shaken France in 2018 and 2019. The immediate trigger of the original movement was the rising price of fuel, which had climbed above two euros per liter.


Meanwhile, an independent wave of high school protests was spreading across France. Students were protesting deteriorating school infrastructure, chronic underfunding of public education, and worsening conditions in classrooms. Hundreds of schools were reportedly occupied or blockaded during the preceding weeks.


These two mobilizations began to reinforce each other, turning October 17 into a focal point for broader social discontent. On TikTok, a veritable media storm unfolded. AI-generated videos, influencers, humorous memes, and countless short clips promoted the demonstrations and in the prospect of a Yellow Vests comeback. Old footage from the movement was recreated, remixed, and circulated to a new generation. High school students were particularly active. In videos shared across social media, groups of students danced to the viral song “Hey Mr. Policeman” in front of police lines during their demonstrations. By Saturday, the mobilization had reached an extraordinary scale.


According to organizers, approximately 800,000 people demonstrated across France. The Interior Ministry estimated 550,000 participants, including 110,000 in Paris. For comparison, during the massive mobilization against the Loi Travail labor reforms on June 14, 2016, organizers estimated that 1.3 million people had taken to the streets nationwide.


The protests developed into widespread urban unrest with

more than 2,000 businesses

 attacked or looted, vehicles set on fire, and government buildings targeted. In Limoges, masked individuals entered the historic 19th-century city hall and set it ablaze. The fire destroyed large parts of the building, including its roof. In Marseille, protesters forced their way into city hall.


“Stop shooting out the eyes of high school students and ordinary people. These are people who are studying. And you’re blinding people, you’re blinding people who are studying. These are people, they’re victims, and you’re hurting them.”


Paris: The Streets Breakaway From the Official March


The morning in Paris began with relatively unsuccessful attempts to mobilize around several railway stations. Groups of protesters were repeatedly surrounded or dispersed by police, preventing them from gathering in larger numbers.


By approximately 2 p.m., however, the center of the mobilization had shifted to Place de la République, where tens of thousands of people assembled. 


As the first confrontations with police began, protesters gathered around the monumental statue of Marianne, the symbolic representation of the French Republic. Activists had dressed the statue in an enormous yellow vest. One side carried a message referring to October 17, 1961, when Paris police massacred Algerian demonstrators protesting a discriminatory curfew. The other side denounced the treatment of students by police in 2026.


The symbolism was unmistakable: the current revolt was being connected to France’s history of colonial violence and contemporary police repression.


What followed was difficult to describe: rather than following the conventional and thus predetermined demonstration route, large groups of protesters began moving in multiple directions.


Traditionally, major demonstrations in Paris follow routes negotiated between unions and authorities, often connecting large squares such as République, Bastille, or Nation. These routes allow police to concentrate their forces and contain demonstrations within relatively predictable boundaries. On October 17, that model collapsed.


Instead of remaining within a single march, protesters …

title: İstanbul merkezli 30 ilde suç örgütü operasyonu: 85 şüpheli gözaltına alındı
content:
İstanbul — İstanbul merkezli 30 ilde suç örgütüne yönelik düzenlenen operasyonda 85 şüpheli gözaltına alındı.

İstanbul Emniyet Müdürlüğü Organize Suçlarla Mücadele Şube Müdürlüğü ekipleri, İstihbarat Şube Müdürlüğü desteği ve İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı koordinesinde, suç örgütlerinin faaliyetlerinin engellenmesi ve şüphelilerin yakalanmasına yönelik çalışma yürüttü.

Çalışmalarda, kent başta olmak üzere ülke genelinde ve uluslararası alanda faaliyet gösteren, elebaşılığını yurt dışında olduğu değerlendirilen ve hakkında kırmızı bülten kararı bulunan bir zanlının yaptığı suç örgütünün sosyal medya platformları üzerinden eleman temin ettiği belirlendi.

Bu yöntemle bulunan şüphelilerin WhatsApp gruplarına dahil edilerek suç eylemleri gerçekleştirmek üzere yönlendirildiklerini ortaya çıkaran ekipler, bu gruplarda eylem hazırlığında oldukları değerlendirilen zanlıların kimlik ve adreslerini tespit etti.

Ekipler, İstanbul, Şırnak, Kayseri, Ankara, Aydın, Bursa, Gaziantep, İzmir, Hatay, Kocaeli, Mersin, Eskişehir, Kilis, Manisa, Mardin, Şanlıurfa, Adana, Antalya, Balıkesir, Batman, Bingöl, Kahramanmaraş, Kırşehir, Muğla, Muş, Ordu, Samsun, Tekirdağ, Trabzon ve Van'da düzenledikleri eş zamanlı operasyonda 35'i adli süreçteki çocuk olmak üzere 85 şüpheliyi yakaladı.

Şüpheliler, işlemleri için emniyete götürüldü.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Testimonianze dalla piazza di Torino del 24 ottobre: violenze poliziesche
content:
Sono state raccolte una serie di testimonianze video e foto rispetto alla violenza poliziesca attuata nei confronti del corteo contro il riarmo e il carovita tenutosi a Torino sabato 24 ottobre.


Alla fine del corteo in particolare le forze dell’ordine hanno impiegato una gestione sconsiderata della piazza, chiudendo a morsa i manifestanti sotto una pioggia di lacrimogeni. Al di là di questo, durante tutto il giorno e anche a corteo concluso, si sono registrate modalità selvagge di attaccare il corteo, tramite cariche, inseguimenti, fermi e provocazioni. Il corteo però è rimasto compatto ed entusiasta del fatto di essere partito e arrivato a portare a termine la manifestazione con una partecipazione incredibile nonostante gli svariati tentativi atti a impedire che essa avvenisse.


Dall’alto diversi video riprendono la sequenza in cui le forze dell’ordine eseguono la chiusura totale del corteo.


A Torino la polizia e carabinieri stanno letteralmente INSEGUENDO in tenuta antisommossa e camionette gli ultimi manifestanti. 


In Corso Emilia e Via regio Parco, prova di forza della polizia per far vedere i muscoli davanti a qualche manifestante.

, ricostruisce il contesto di Piazza Castello in questo video

author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Μια «αυτοκτονία» στα χέρια του κράτους είναι, ουσιαστικά, θανατική ποινή
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Μια «αυτοκτονία» στα χέρια του κράτους είναι, ουσιαστικά, θανατική ποινή


Η Βαλάντω ήταν λίγο παραπάνω από 20 χρονών, Ρομνί και χρειαζόταν ψυχολογική υποστήριξη, όπως λένε οι συγκρατούμενές της. Είχε καταδικαστεί για μικροκλοπές. Μπήκε στη φυλακή επειδή η κυβέρνηση αυτή πιστεύει θρησκευτικά στη φυλακή. Είχε λίγο ακόμα να βγει, αλλά δεν ήξερε πόσο, δεν ήταν σε θέση να ξέρει. Χόρευε και τραγουδούσε με ένα πλαστικό ποτήρι για τουμπερλέκι.


Στις

συνεντεύξεις

 που πήραμε τηλεφωνικά από τα τρία προφυλακισμένα άτομα για τη σκευωρία «Μαρφίν Vol. 3», η Ελένη στις 3 Οκτωβρίου μας έλεγε, σκιαγραφώντας την κατάσταση με την πληθώρα κρατουμένων για πλημμελήματα, για την περίπτωση της Βαλάντως:


Στις 20 Οκτωβρίου η Βαλάντω αυτοκτόνησε.


Οι συγκρατούμενές της προχώρησαν σε διαμαρτυρία. Την επόμενη μέρα, 21 Οκτωβρίου, δημοσίευσαν το ακόλουθο κείμενο:


Κάθε θάνατος εντός των τειχών της φυλακής είναι κρατική δολοφονία


Στις 20/10/2026 η συγκρατούμενή μας Βαλεντίνα Τ. προκειμένου να ξεφύγει από τις άθλιες συνθήκες των ελληνικών φυλακών «επέλεξε» να αφαιρέσει τη ζωή της. Η Βαλεντίνα ήταν ένα βασανισμένο κορίτσι σε νεαρή ηλικία που υπέφερε τόσα πολλά, τόσο στον άδικο έξω κόσμο, όσο και μέσα στην φυλακή, αφού το δικαστικό σύστημα αποφάσισε για μια μικροκλοπή να κριθεί ένοχη. Έτσι βρέθηκε έγκλειστη σε ένα περιβάλλον που δεν της πρόσφερε καμιά βοήθεια αλλά αντιθέτως επιβάρυνε την ψυχική της υγεία, καθώς η ίδια έχριζε ψυχολογικής υποστήριξης. Μέσα σε ένα διάστημα πέντε μηνών ερχόμαστε αντιμέτωπες για 2η φορά με τον άδικο θάνατο ακόμα μιας συγκρατούμενής μας, ακόμη μιας γυναίκας που άφησε την τελευταία της πνοή και τα όνειρά της για ελευθερία μέσα στους τσιμεντένιους τοίχους της φυλακής.


Όπως η Βαλεντίνα έτσι και πολλές από μας βιώνουμε καθημερινά τις άθλιες και εξευτελιστικές συνθήκες διαβίωσης εντός των Καταστημάτων Κράτησης και πιο συγκεκριμένα βρισκόμαστε αντιμέτωπες με τις ελλιπείς παροχές σε ιατροφαρμακευτική περίθαλψη, σε καταρτισμένο ιατρικό προσωπικό, με την απουσία ψυχολόγου και τη σωστή ψυχική καθοδήγηση και υποστήριξή μας καθώς και τις άσχημες συνθήκες υγιεινής και κράτησης. Είναι αδιανόητο πως στις Γυναικείες Φυλακές Κορυδαλλού η θέση του ψυχολόγου παραμένει κενή εδώ και πέντε έτη παρά τα συνεχή αιτήματα των κρατουμένων.


Το μόνο που προσφέρει το συγκεκριμένο Κατάστημα Κράτησης είναι ένας ψυχίατρος που δεν είναι διαθέσιμος σε τακτική βάση και το μόνο που προσφέρει είναι να χορηγεί απλώς ψυχοφάρμακα χωρίς τις απαραίτητες συνεδρίες και γνωματεύσεις, δίχως ουσιαστική βοήθεια.


Ο εγκλεισμός σε συνδυασμό με τη ψυχική πίεση που υφίσταται η κάθε μία από μας, δυσκολεύει κατά πολύ τη διαβίωση μας εδώ μέσα.


Επιπλέον με τον νέο σωφρονιστικό κώδικα και την αυστηροποίηση των ποινών, η ποσότητα των κρατουμένων αυξάνεται ασφυκτικά με αποτέλεσμα τον υπερπληθυσμό σε όλες τις ελληνικές φυλακές.


Για όλους αυτούς τους λόγους και για να τιμήσουμε την μνήμη της συγκρατούμενής μας Βαλεντίνας πραγματοποιήσαμε διαμαρτυρία κατά την οποία προσπαθήσαμε να αρνηθούμε το μεσημεριανό κλείσιμο, καταφέραμε μόνο να το παρατείνουμε για 1 ώρα αφού αιφνιδιαστικά μας έκλεισαν στα κελιά μας.


Τα αιτήματα μας είναι:


1) Μόνιμο καταρτισμένο ιατρικό προσωπικό


2) Μόνιμος ψυχολόγος και ψυχίατρος


3) Να υπάρξουν καλύτερες συνθήκες υγιεινής και κράτησης


4) Να δοθεί ένα τέλος στην αυστηροποίηση των ποινών και στον υπερπληθυσμό στις φυλακές.


Οι ζωές των κρατουμένων μετράνε.


Γυναικείες Φυλακές Κορυδαλλού


21/10/2026


Θάνατοι και υπερπληθυσμός


Η Βαλάντω δεν ήταν η πρώτη κρατούμενη που αυτοκτόνησε φέτος. Για το 2025 και το 2026 έχουν καταγραφεί δημοσιογραφικά τουλάχιστον 6 περιστατικά αυτοκτονιών στις φυλακές. Η σχετική έκθεση του Συμβουλίου της Ευρώπης (

SPACE I

author: dev
title: Lettre ouverte de prisonniers du 17 octobre 2026
content:
Depuis des semaines, la répression contre le mouvement en cours s'intensifie. Au lendemain du 17 octobre, le Garde des sceaux Gérald Darmanin, foulant toute séparation des pouvoirs, enjoignait la magistrature à condamner le plus durement possible les manifestant interpellés et poursuivis. Nombre d'entre eux, dorment donc désormais en prison. Des prisonniers du 17 octobre sont parvenus à nous transmettre cette lettre ouverte, comme un aveux et un appel à continuer la lutte.


Nous vous écrivons depuis une prison d'Ile-de-France dont ne nous vous communiquerons pas le nom, ceci afin de nous protéger des risques de représailles et surtout des administrations judiciaires et pénitentiaires.


Nous sommes étudiants, lycéens, professeurs, chômeurs, restaurateurs, petits entrepreneurs, livreurs, gangsters, de tous les quartiers et de toutes les villes de la région, de Créteil, de Bobigny, de Belleville, de Montreuil, de Bagnolet, de Noisy-le-Sec, de Seine-et-Marne, de Seine-Saint-Denis et de Paris. Nous sommes de tous les âges, de toutes les couleurs de peau et de toutes les nationalités, nous sommes des Arabes, des Blancs, des Noirs, des Tziganes, des Turcs, des Allemands, des Français.


Nous avons été accusés à tort ou à raison d'avoir pillé, d'avois commis des violences contre les forces de l'ordre, de nous être attroupés illégalement, d'avoir dissimulé nos visages. Peu importe finalement nos situations ou ce qu'on pouvait nous reprocher, car les tribunaux se sont pliés aux ordres de la macronie pour nous envoyer tous en taule. Même si les prisons sont toutes plus insalubres et surpeuplées les unes que les autres, tant que ça rentre !


Cela nous rappelle à quel point ce que l'on nomme la Justice, n'est en rien une institution indépendante, d'autant moins lorsque l'État et la bourgeoise se sentent menacés.


En prison, nous avons le privilège de pouvoir nous abrutir toute la journée devant BFMTV, CNEWS et les chaînes des autres chiens de garde du régime. L'offensive idéologique sur ces plateaux télé vient soutenir la politique répressive de ceux qui pensent nous gouverner. Cette offensive est à la hauteur de la peur qui les traverse depuis samedi dernier. Il s'agissait d'un véritable avertissement révolutionnaire. Partout, ils essayent désormais de nous faire regretter, fléchir, de nous dissuader de revenir les samedis suivants. Ils taisent le soutien, la fierté et tous ces petits mots que nous avons pu lire et entendre depuis ces derniers jours du type « j'aurais aimé être là » ou bien encore « vous leur avez fait payer ». Ils veulent nous faire croire que notre violence est comparable aux milliers de vie broyées par le capitalisme au quotidien.


Si les serviteurs médiatiques du pouvoir ne parviennent pas à déterminer le « profil type » des insurgés, c'est que nous autres sommes le peuple qui s'est soulevé. Le peuple qui souffre et qui désormais se bat pour ne plus souffrir. Ils tentent de nous diviser, de nous catégoriser en manifestants, casseurs, pilleurs, racailles ou d'ultra-gauche. Mais ils n'ont pas compris que nous sommes tout cela à la fois ! Nous sommes unis par notre colère et notre désir de révolution. Une révolution qui nous redonne la possibilité de respirer et d'espérer, de partager et de mettre en commun. De nous permettre enfin de décider de la manière dont nous voulons vivre. Une révolution qui mette fin à cette humiliation qui dégueule de luxe.


Cette rage sociale nous a poussé dans la rue samedi dernier, c'est la même que l'on retrouve dans les couloirs et les cellules de la prison où nous sommes enfermés. Cette rage explique aussi le soutien et le respect des autres détenus pour les insurgés du 17 octobre. Nous n'accepterons pas non plus que nous soyons séparés entre d'un côté les prisonniers politiques et les prisonniers de droit commun car nous avons tous été poussés dans les prisons de ce régime par ce monde injuste.


Pour toutes ces raisons, nous vous le disons avec force, nous ne regrettons rien ! Rien si ce n'est de ne pas nous être suffisamment protégés contre la violence répressive qui allait s'abattre sur nous.


Nous appelons donc toutes celles et ceux qui sont dehors à continuer à tenir face à l'État et à retourner dans la rue chaque samedi, jusqu'à la chute de Macron et de tout son monde pourrissant.


Nous vous appelons à vous organiser entre chaque samedi, à vous vous rencontrer, à vous préparer et à prendre vos vies en main dès maintenant.


Nous vous appelons à soutenir tous les …

title: Après la débâcle policière, les tribunaux montrent les muscles. Récit des comparutions immédiates à Marseille après la manif du 17 octobre
content:
Le ministère de la Justice a demandé à ses agents de la dureté. Alors l'ambiance est à la punition collective, yeux fermés marteau à la main !


On parle de 100interpellations, dont 80%des majeurs. Beaucoup d'entre eux seront transféré au tribunal pour des comparutions immédiates. C'est une forme de justice expéditive, expliquée

ici


Plusieurs salles sont réservées au tribunal de Marseille rien que pour ça, de lundi à jeudi.


Le procureur général est là en personne, Nicolas Bessonne, il peut faire son show et déballer ses analyses politico-stratégiques… on l'entendra dire « Il est établi qu'il y a eu une action concertée entre deux types de populations de nature différentes. La catégorie black-bloc attaque des institutions avec pour objectif de fixer les CRS, tandis qu'au même moment arrive, de manière concertée, un autre type de population : des personnes sans papier et des jeunes des quartiers, dans le but de piller ». Le tribunal est décidément un monde clos, coupé de la société.


On va voir pendant ces 4jours d'audiences exceptionnelles de comparutions immédiates le théatre de la justice raciste, classiste, sexiste, moralisante et qui se voit comme dernier rampart républicain à la barbarie… des juges envoyer des gens en prison après 20minutes de pseudo débat contradictoire. Envoyer des gens en prison direct le jour même, après 48h de garde à vue, pour avoir été arrêté en possession d'objets volés samedi soir.


Et comme d'habitude les débats sont incompréhensibles pour les personnes jugées qui sont non francophone tellement aucune place n'est laissé à la possibilité d'une traduction . Les plaidoirie des avocat.e.s commis d'office font souvent mal aux oreilles tellement ils rabaissent leur client.es. Et bien sûr personne ne parle dans les micros donc même si les audienes sont sensées être publiques on entend rien, c'est caché.


On a aussi vu La métropole venir faire la victime et se porter partie civile dans chaque audience dans le but de demander de l'argent à chaque personne jugée, et déployer son discours du désastre et des millions d'euros de dégâts. On avait vu les mêmes pleurs de l'avocat de la métropole en 2023 après les révoltes suite à l'assassinat de Nahel : dire que la personne en possession d'une paire de chassure volé serait coupable complice des millions d'euros supposés de dégâts en ville…


Il y a beaucoup de similitudes avec 2023, des audiences où la justice se donne en spectacle et veut montrer à tout le monde sa force sa rigueur son intransigeance : on voit surtout des gens aller en prison pour des chaussures ou du maquillage : la justice au service de l'État en panique qui veut taper fort !


On connaît l'état des prisons surchargés. Mais les peines de prison sont la norme pendant ces audiences.


On voit des dossiers confus (le gars arrêté parce qu'il fait une vidéo des pillages, ou le gars qui court, etc.) où les flics ont fait n'importe quoi, taper dans le tas : y'a pas d'objets volés, y'a des témoignages de flic contradictoire, y'a pas de victime, donc jugement final : relaxe.


Mais c'est minime.


On voit quelques personnes demander le renvoi de l'audience le temps de préparer sa défense, donc commence un débat sur leur maintien en détention jusque cette date ou leur sortie et sous quelles conditions. Donc certaines sortent avec un contrôle judiciaire (pointage au commissariat, interdiction de manif ou de présence à Marseille, couvre feu individuel de 22h à 6h, etc) jusqu'a leur procès en décembre. Et certaines sont maintenues en détention, elles sont donc envoyées aux Baumettes en détention provisoire jusqu'à fin novembre/décembre.


Pour celleux qui accepte d'être jugées le jour meme on voit :


Une meuf arrêtée avec une paire de chaussure neuve et du maquillage prend 12mois de prison dont 6 avec sursis, est condamnée à payer 1000€ aux 2policiers qu'elles aurait insulté lors de son interpellation et en plus elle doit payer leur avocat qui vient porter plainte contre elle : 1000€ en plus.


Pour des histoires où y'a pas de vol, mais des délits liés au fait même qu'ils se sont fait interpellé.es par les flics. Des histoires de rebellion ou d'outrage : des peines de prison 6mois avec sursis simple et en plus des amendes de 500€ environ.


Pour des possession d'objets volés, du recel : on voit par exemple des peines de 6-10mois avec sursis pour des jouets ou des chaussures, du maquillage etc. Et en plus des fois des interdiction de manifester pendant 2 ans.

author: Thorin Klosowski
title: Lessons Learned From 'AdFection' and What To Do Next
content:
Last week,

researchers at Citizen Lab revealed

 a horrifying new malware campaign, dubbed “AdFection.” It used an ad network to distribute spyware to journalist’s devices to infect them without the target ever needing to click anything. This sort of attack on journalists is dangerous and incredibly concerning, especially since it’s built on the backbone of a technology we already object to:

behavioral advertising

. Although this type of attack has only been described targeting journalists, you can take a few steps we outline in the next section to mitigate the risk no matter who you are.


A few factors combined to make this attack a noteworthy first-of-its-kind. First, it utilized the surveillance ad-tech ecosystem to specially target the malicious code. Second, the spyware it delivered was so-called “zero-click,” meaning it required no interaction from the user to be infected: all that is required is for the ad to be delivered and code bundled along with it to be run, which happens automatically. Neither

malvertising

 nor

zero-click attacks

 are new on their own. What’s novel about the AdFection attack is combining them, creating a highly targeted, extremely dangerous attack which is difficult to defend against and even harder to detect.


Let’s take a deeper look from the perspective of one of the Windows devices supplied to the researchers from Al Jazeera. Here’s how the report describes the infection happening: 


Someone browsing the web or using an app on that machine is served an ad created by Discover-Tech, a company exposed in the report as “purporting to be a legitimate advertising company, [but] appears to be a front for large-scale ad espionage abuse.” 


The ad contains a small snippet of JavaScript code which is automatically executed when rendered in the app or website. 


This code reaches back out to a Discover-Tech server, referred to as their “NOAS server,” with detailed information about the machine rendering it: its cookie-set advertising ID, IP address, and more.


So far, nothing particularly unusual has happened. Ads that contain JavaScript code and reach back out to their servers with lots of information on your device—and by extension you—are commonplace. It’s all part of the data-driven advertising ecosystem. What happens next is more interesting:


The NOAS server uses this detailed information to determine it is an Al Jazeera machine requesting the ad. 


Instead of returning an empty response (as it does most of the time), it responds with a malicious, zero-click spyware

payload

. That payload was created by Discover-Tech’s partner Candiru/Integrity Labs, a company

previously


exposed

 for involvement in sophisticated malware attacks. 


The payload is then executed and infects the targeted machine.


Companies targeting zero-click malware attacks against journalists might seem like the plot of a blockbuster spy thriller. But this attack was enabled by the everyday practices of ad-tech companies, which unfortunately have extreme latitude in the collection of users’ data. By leveraging the tracking identifiers and data collected on devices for the purpose of delivering targeted ads to specific individuals, mercenary spyware companies can repurpose this data in order to fine-tune who they infect—and hide that they’re doing it from everyone else. 


Most ads are not delivered directly by the ad creators, but rather by intermediaries that

facilitate Real-Time Bidding auctions

. Nonetheless, winning bidders are given the ability to execute JavaScript code in the browser of the person who receives the targeted ad. This allows for interactive ads to be displayed, but also (as we’ve seen) for the compromise of a device just by delivery of malicious code.


While the different components in this

attack chain

 are not novel on their own, the exposure of this combined attack is significant because it reveals a technique to hyper-target individuals and organizations for infection. Luckily, there are steps you can take to protect yourself from the

myriad


of


dangers


presented


by

 the ad-tracking industry. Here’s how.


What You Can Do About It


As we work towards fundamental fixes to the ad ecosystem and banning online behavioral ads altogether, the onus is on all of us to protect ourselves. This is especially important for higher risk individuals or journalists working in states with heavy surveillance.

 several steps, depending on your threat …

title: La bande à « Balance ton Claude »
content:
Nous avons déjà longuement abordé les ressorts de l'« affaire Thélyson Orélien » dans nos pages (nous renvoyons, entre autres, à

cet excellent texte de Jean Claude Noel

). L'enquête qui suit porte sur ses délateurs, la bande à « Balance ton Claude » du nom du compte X à l'origine de la polémique. On y découvre que l'affaire Thélyson Orélien, est un double écran de fumée qui masque une convergence d'intérêts, financiers, idéologiques et géopolitiques, entre l'industrie de l'IA, les libertariens de la Silicon Valley, les christo-fascistes de l'administration Trump, et leurs imitateurs bien-de-chez-nous.


« Démarche complètement apolitique », « lanceur d'alerte », anonymat nécessaire pour éviter les attaques

ad hominem

… Toutes ces auto-justifications offertes par la bande à « Balance ton Claude », qui est derrière la polémique Thélyson Orélien, servent à ripoliner une opération idéologique, menée par un groupe de jeunes « libéraux-conservateurs » (doux euphémisme), très actifs dans l'espace médiatique, depuis les colonnes du Figaro, et les fabriques à propagande du projet Périclès. En outre, ces alarmes hypocrites s'inscrivent dans les récits

IApocalyptiques

 déployés par l'industrie pour faire gonfler investissements publics et privés. Une bulle profitant surtout aux nouveaux technoligarques, qui sont prêts à jeter la démocratie et l'humanité entière dans le chaudron de la valorisation et de la domination sans partage.


Les problèmes posés par la rédaction

I

A

ssistée

cachent une autre forme d'imposture : les allégations de neutralité politique répétées par la bande à « Balance ton Claude ». Une fine équipe, composée de cinq membres, d'après le premier accusateur anonyme sorti du bois

 [

1

]

, et qui n'a pas eu droit à la même attention que Thélyson Orélien.


«

Notre démarche était complètement apolitique

 [

2

]


 »

, déclarait ainsi Samuel Fitoussi dans

Le Point

, après avoir tombé le masque. Pourtant, le profil de nos Claudettes risque d'affoler votre détecteur à

bullshit

. Pas besoin du logiciel Pangram, vous allez voir, pour confondre ces immenses tartufes, présentés comme des «

lanceurs d'alerte

ayant

 l'amour de la vérité chevillé au coeur

et dénonçant les impostures intellectuelles

 [

3

]

 ».


Samuel Fitoussi


Commençons par vous donner une idée de l'honnêteté intellectuelle de M. Fitoussi. Quelques heures après avoir lancé la polémique sur le livre de Thélyson Orélien depuis le compte X « Balance ton Claude » (encore anonyme à ce moment-là), le chroniqueur du

Figaro

 intervient sur Radio J, où il déclare : «

comme aujourd'hui, le RN n'est pas un parti particulièrement violent ou antisémite ou quoi que ce soit, [renvoyer dos à dos les extrêmes] c'est en fait banaliser la dangerosité de cette gauche pro-Hamas...

 »


La journaliste lui fait alors remarquer que l'extrême-droite est quand même «

très proche de l'AfD, un parti néo-nazi

 ». Réponse de Samuel Fitoussi : «

J'ai beaucoup de critiques à l'égard de ces partis. Pour le RN, par exemple, je les trouve étatistes, socialistes, relativement incompétents

 […]

mais je pense qu'il faut reconnaître que les choses ont évolué, que le RN n'est plus le RN d'il y a 30 ans, et c'est même plus le RN d'il y a dix ans, qui voulait sortir de l'Union européenne, et c'est plus le RN antisémite

 [

4

]

 ».

L

'amour de la vérité chevillé au cœur

, on vous dit.


Par ailleurs, l'intérêt de M. Fitoussi pour les implications de l'IA générative n'est pas pure curiosité, étant donné qu'il travaille pour le fonds d'investissement FRST CAPITAL, spécialisé dans l'industrie naissante du

machine learning

(un des domaines informatiques que l'on trouve derrière la formule générique « IA », et dont les avancées ont notamment permis le développement des « grands modèles de langage » – ou

LLM

 – comme le célèbre ChatGPT).


Incidemment, FRST CAPITAL est une ancienne filiale d'OTIUM CAPITAL, la holding de Pierre-Edouard Stérin, milliardaire christo-libertarien qui utilise ses gains pour financer un projet de conquête politique par l'extrême-droite, baptisé « Périclès » (pour Patriotes, Enracinés, Résistants, Identitaires, Chrétiens, Libéraux, Européens, Souverainistes), et doté d'un budget de 150 millions d'euros

 [

5

]

.


Cerise sur le gâteau : FIRST CAPITAL n'investit pas seulement dans les « laboratoires d'IA », mais également dans la fabrique d'opinion, en produisant des sondages douteux sur la popularité d'Elon Musk ou …

title: Terminal Kadıköy’ün reklam ekranı hack’lendi: “Bu bina kent suçudur”
content:
İstanbul'un Kadıköy Söğütlüçeşme’deki Terminal Kadıköy’de bulunan bir reklam ekranı, “BU BİNA KENT SUÇUDUR” yazısıyla hack’lendi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, deprem toplanma alanı ve yeşil alanın alışveriş merkezine (AVM) dönüştürülmesine tepki göstererek kentlerin her alanının kâr maksimizasyonuna göre planlandığını vurguladı.


ETHA’daki habere göre, Söğütlüçeşme Tren İstasyonu’nun viyadük altındaki alanında kurulan Terminal Kadıköy, Nisan 2025’ten bu yana işletiliyor. Açıldığı günden bu yana onlarca dükkânın faaliyet gösterdiği alan, yeni bir tüketim merkezine dönüştü.


Kent hakkı savunucuları, ekoloji örgütleri ve Kadıköylüler, projeye karşı yıllardır itirazlarını sürdürüyor. Haydarpaşa Dayanışması, projeyi “soylulaştırma merkezi” olarak nitelendirerek “Kamusal alanlar ticarileşiyor, bu bir kent suçudur” açıklamasını yapmıştı.


Savunucular, AVM’ye dönüştürülen alanın geçmişte sokakta yaşayan hayvanların kent sakinleri tarafından beslendiği geniş bir yeşil alan olduğunu belirtiyor. Bölgenin yıllarca “izbe bir alan, güvensiz bir yer” olarak tanımlandığını aktaran kent hakkı savunucuları, bu söylemle projeye toplumsal rıza oluşturulmaya çalışıldığını ifade ediyor.


500’den fazla ağaç kesildi


Proje kapsamında bölgede 500’den fazla ağaç kesildi. Kent hakkı savunucuları, Söğütlüçeşme’deki alanın deprem toplanma alanı niteliği taşıdığını ve projenin bu işlevi fiilen ortadan kaldırdığını belirtiyor.


Savunucular, “Hem bir deprem toplanma alanı hem kentsel bir yeşil alanın tümü, bir avuç AVM’ye kurban edildi” diyerek kamusal alanın sermayeye peşkeş çekilmesine tepki göstermişti.


Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı ise proje için “ÇED Gerekli Değildir” kararı vermişti.


Terminal Kadıköy sonrası Kadıköy’de artan yoğunluk ve trafik baskısı


14 Nisan 2026


(EMK)

content:
Siber Güvenlik Başkanlığı, dünya genelinde yaygın olarak kullanılan PHP yazılım altyapısında kritik güvenlik açıkları tespit edildiğini belirterek şu açıklamayı yaptı “Dünya genelinde yaygın olarak kullanılan PHP yazılım altyapısında kritik güvenlik açıkları tespit edilmiştir.

Başkanlığımız, söz konusu zafiyetlerin oluşturabileceği risklerin erken tespiti ve olası etkilerinin sınırlandırılması amacıyla ulusal ölçekte güvenlik taramalarını başlatmış, ilgili kurum ve kuruluşlara acil güvenlik bildirimlerini iletmiştir.

Kamu kurumlarımızın, kritik altyapı işletmecilerimizin ve özel sektör kuruluşlarımızın sistemlerini gözden geçirerek gerekli güvenlik güncellemelerini ivedilikle uygulamaları önem taşımaktadır.

Dijital altyapılarımızın güvenliği ve kritik hizmetlerin sürekliliği için ulusal düzeyde koordinasyon ve önleyici güvenlik çalışmalarımız sürmektedir.”

author: Blanca Missé
title: As More Unions Oppose ICE and Israel, the Right Is Cracking Down
content:
The right is trying to gain access to labor unions’ minutes, membership lists, and Zoom chats.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

On September 22, The Free Press attacked the California Faculty Association (CFA), which represents about 29,000 faculty, librarians, counselors, and coaches across the California State University (CSU) system. Drawing on private discussions about a proposed Jewish caucus, including communications from a union Zoom meeting, the article accused CFA of antisemitism. How those communications reached the publication remains unclear. Two days later, the Jewish Journal amplified those allegations, urging Gov. Gavin Newsom to consider them as he weighed California Assembly Bill (AB) 2551, CFA-sponsored legislation challenging campus protest restrictions imposed after the 2024 Palestine solidarity encampments. Less than a week after The Free Press story was published, Newsom vetoed the bill.

Pro-Israel and Jewish advocacy organizations had already campaigned against AB 2551 before the union’s internal deliberations were targeted, arguing that greater scrutiny would weaken rules needed to protect Jewish students from harassment and intimidation. Newsom’s veto does not prove coordination, but the campaign portraying CFA as hostile to Jewish students had become entangled with the union’s fight against campus protest restrictions.

The CSU’s systemwide policy prohibits encampments, overnight demonstrations, and unauthorized structures. The CSU Academic Senate immediately condemned the restrictions as undermining academic freedom when it was instituted in 2024, while CFA warned that vague definitions of disruption threatened constitutionally protected speech, assembly, protest, and future strike activity. A major 2026 ACLU-Amnesty study, investigating 80 campuses over two years, documented sweeping repression of Palestine solidarity protests. As the report found, universities “have imposed sweeping restrictions on student speech, initiated disciplinary actions against students, and imposed severe punishments, including expulsions and suspensions.” The ACLU has insisted that even legitimate time, place, and manner restrictions “must leave ample room for students to express themselves.”

The controversy reaches beyond CFA and CSU. Unions and rank-and-file organizations committed to Palestine solidarity have been forced to relitigate, again and again, whether anti-Zionism and solidarity with Palestinians constitute antisemitism — and whether such organizing should be systematically policed, investigated, or surveilled. At stake is a more fundamental right of the exploited: Can workers democratically connect economic struggles with Palestine solidarity, resistance to anti-immigrant and anti-Black racism, and the defense of civil liberties without exposing their organizing and deliberations to external pressure or repression?

We already have a word for the use of legal process as a political weapon: lawfare. You do not necessarily have to win. Investigation, expense, compelled disclosure, and possible sanctions can exact their own price.

Call its media counterpart pressfare: leaked material, selective or doctored quotations, and public identification can turn people into political targets and invite pressure on employers, universities, or government agencies.

The leaked CFA meeting should not be adjudicated through fragments selected for publication, especially when CFA’s statewide record contradicts the portrayal of a union indifferent to antisemitism. During the 2024 encampments, CFA opposed antisemitism and Islamophobia “in all forms” while supporting the encampments. Amid a 2025 federal antisemitism investigation, it stated that “as CFA members, we are united against antisemitism; it has no place in our communities,” while defending members’ academic freedom. CFA’s Palestine, Arab, and Muslim Caucus likewise defines its mission as confronting racism “in all its manifestations,” explicitly including antisemitism. The Free Press story — a clear example of pressfare — sought to overwrite this legacy with weaponized accusations, undermining the trust that workers place in the sanctity of their union spaces and processes.

Antisemitism demands to be taken seriously — which is why accusations of anti-Jewish discrimination should not be instrumentalized. Kenneth Stern, director of the Bard Center for the Study of Hate, has …

author: Franco Giandana Gigena
title: Openness in AI development: a path to long-term independence
content:
As concerns grow over

deepening dependencies

 on a handful of Big Tech companies and the

outsized influence

 of the U.S. and China, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk used his speech during July’s inaugural

Global Dialogue on AI Governance

 to call on humans to

“take back our agency”

 over AI. But what does agency over AI really mean? What policies and practices can allow people to shape AI in ways that respect, rather than undermine,

human rights

? 


This blog post unpacks concrete initiatives that show how openness in AI development can increase people’s agency over AI and advance the development of public interest technology. At the same time, we reflect on how openness is not the same thing as mere access, and how short-term pragmatism can pave the way toward long-term independence.


Why is AI development so concentrated? 


Last year, the UN formally established an

Independent International Scientific Panel on AI

, intended to “advance scientific understanding and ensure that international deliberations are informed by the best available evidence.” The panel’s

preliminary report

, published this past July, contained a stark warning about the concentration of AI capabilities in a small number of firms and countries, which it says “could enable authoritarian capture and undermine democratic accountability.” But how has this concentration of power come about? 


One of the main reasons is that

building

 a complete, multilayered “

AI stack

” is both an astronomical investment and a complex technical challenge. This technological stack comprises:


The hardware layer, which provides the computing power that AI demands, mainly via advanced chips known as graphics processing units, or GPUs; 


The data layer, used for training and post-training; 


The model layer, which consists of the models themselves, such as GPT-4 or Claude, and the tools to service them; 


And finally, the application layer, which is the interface that users interact with. 


Currently, the U.S. and China are the only two countries realistically capable of building a fully national version of the entire stack, where they build and control all necessary infrastructure within their borders. However, even then, they would continue to depend on other countries for some elements, whether that’s for sourcing the chips or the critical minerals used in the hardware layer. Meanwhile, most other countries’ reliance on U.S. or Chinese companies creates critical safety and accessibility vulnerabilities. 


However, all is not lost for other countries and regions that want to build agency across the stack. There are several parts in the AI stack — notably

the data, model, and application layers

 — where greater openness and geopolitical collaboration could help foster collective agency. In this way, we can work towards what Martin Tisné, founder and CEO of the Collaborative for AI in the Public Interest, calls a “

global, open, resilient, non-aligned stack

” adaptable to local needs. 


How does openness support greater agency over AI? 


When considering how to gain more agency over AI, it’s worth looking at the free and open source software (FOSS) movement; a longstanding and major driver pushing for increased agency over technology, from the software running the internet, to the tools millions of people rely on every day, such as the Firefox internet browser. Although definitions of FOSS vary from

source

 to

source

, the essential principle means ensuring that anyone can access a given technology’s source code, study how it works, modify it, and share modified or unmodified copies with others.


The Open Source Initiative (

OSI

) has already applied this in the context of AI, with their

open source AI definition (OSAID)

 according to which an open source AI system is one that enables four key freedoms:


Use

 the system for any purpose and without having to ask for permission.


Study

 how the system works and understand how its results were created.


Modify

 the system for any purpose, including to change its output.


Share

 the system for others to use with or without modifications, for any purpose.


None of the offerings from major AI tool providers, such as OpenAI or Anthropic, currently enable any of these freedoms. Until now, the overwhelming preference in AI development has been for closed systems, accessible only through online interfaces or

application programming interfaces (APIs)

. This …

author: EDRi
title: EDRi celebrates Global Encryption Day 2026
content:
On 21 October 2026, we celebrate the Global Encryption Day! Part of EDRi’s KISS campaign, we celebrate this day with our partners, online, in Brussels and in different European capitals.

On 21 October 2026, we celebrate the Global Encryption Day! Part of EDRi’s KISS campaign, we celebrate this day with our partners, online, in Brussels and in different European capitals.

A recent survey conducted by CDT Europe shows that across several European countries (France, Sweden, Poland, and Ireland), people consistently oppose measures that would compromise encrypted communication platforms. In France, 92% of respondents agree they have the right to have private conversations online, while the figure goes to 94% in Poland, 88% in Sweden and 93% in Ireland.

Encryption is great for protecting the way our messages travel on the internet. Through “end to end encryption”, anyone can make sure that the content of an online conversation can not be intruded upon, not even the server that facilitates the transmission.

This year, we have coordinated several campaign actions to celebrate encryption.

1. Raising awareness in European Capitals through LED “Encryption trucks” driving around Paris, Berlin and Dublin and a metro poster campaign in Prague.

To visibilise people’s support for encryption, we partnered with the Irish Council for Civil Liberties, Féministes contre le cyberharcèlement and Digitale Gesellschaft who are in the streets today, talking to people and press about the “Encryption trucks” and the importance of encryption. In Prague, our partner Iure has been supporting the Metro Posters campaign for the past weeks.

2. Working across silos with groups promoting gender justice, and sex workers rights in the digitalised society.

In the case of women defenders, land defenders from indigenous groups, racial justice activists, sex workers defenders and defenders of migrants, unsafe communications can have life or death consequences. For human rights defenders, secure and trusted communication is often a matter of physical safety and democratic organising.

For 21 October 2026, we have partnered with European Sex Workers Alliance and Féministes contre le cyberharcèlement (France) to raise awareness on the importance of safe and secure communications for sex workers as well as womens’ rights. Check ESWA’s Instagram video and

3. Visibilising the testimonials of activists from Privacy Camp and across Europe

During 14th edition of Privacy Camp gathering that happened recently in Brussels, EDRi asked a few participants why encryption mattered for them. The people we interviewed came from a variety of causes: those fighting for a healthy European civic space, and for digital rights in Netherlands, Portugal and Germany. More, we asked EDRi’s over 35.000 supporters why encryption mattered to them too. Their answers inspired us to post some of them, and we will post them during the next couple of weeks. Check the content on EDRi’s social media channels – on Instagram , Mastodon or LinkedIn.

4. Connecting with global experts to advocate for encryption

During the Global Encryption Summit taking place at 4pm CET, EDRi’s expert Chloé Berthélémy will join a panel in an event organised by Internet Society, the Center for Democracy and Technology, Mozilla, and Global Partners Digital.

Europol and law enforcement are pushing to legalise hacking methods that weaken encryption. These methods rely on ordering a service provider (those who develop or maintain the software, computer system, network, or electronic device) to build vulnerabilities in their systems. With this demand, state actors want to enable the police or intelligence agencies to have access to our data and break encryption. Client-side scanning (scanning of all content such as text,images, videos, etc. on a device or shared in a communication channel) is a method proposed under the EU CSA Regulation. Key escrows or “key recovery”, involves placing decryption keys in a “vault” managed by a trusted authority or group of trusted authorities, who can break them out when access to the encrypted data is needed. Finally, ghost proposals refer to the modification of the encryption system to enable a third-party listener to be silently added to encrypted conversations.

In democratic societies, communication systems are vital for our lives and connections with others. Safe and secure communications and devices allow us to work, socialise, organise, express ourselves, and connect …

author: Fundi Skweyiya-Gushu
title: Africa’s Cybersecurity Gap Is Not a Treaty Problem. It Is a Readiness Problem
content:
Africa’s digital economy is expanding faster than its ability to protect it.

INTERPOL’s African Cyberthreat Assessment Report 2026

, drawing on information from 36 countries, found that artificial intelligence was involved in 55 per cent of reported cybercrimes across the continent. Reported losses rose from $192 million in 2024 to $484 million, while 72 per cent of surveyed countries reported scam centres operating within their borders.


The figures expose a growing vulnerability. Africa’s digital transformation is creating economic opportunities but also expanding the terrain on which criminals operate. The question is whether African institutions can respond collectively when attacks cross borders, exploit financial systems and use AI to target victims at scale.


Morocco Cybersecurity Week

, held in Rabat from 12 to 14 October 2026, placed regional cooperation firmly on the agenda. The emphasis was appropriate. Yet Africa’s challenge extends beyond convening officials and announcing strategies. It is making institutions cooperate effectively under pressure.


Africa does not lack legal frameworks.

The African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

, known as the

Malabo Convention,

 entered into force in June 2023 after years of delays. Morocco, meanwhile acceded to the

Council of Europe’s Budapest Convention on Cybercrime

 in 2018 and signed its

Second Additional Protocol on electronic evidence

 in 2022.


These instruments provide important foundations for criminal investigations, data protection and cross-border cooperation. But legal commitments cannot, on their own, ensure that investigators obtain evidence quickly, financial institutions exchange actionable intelligence or police services coordinate an effective response.


Cybercrime crosses institutional boundaries. A fraudulent transaction may involve a mobile-money provider, a bank, a telecommunications company, a cryptocurrency exchange and digital infrastructure spread across several jurisdictions. Each holds part of the evidence. When requests are delayed or responsibilities are unclear, investigators lose valuable time while criminals move money and erase their tracks. African institutions must therefore measure cooperation by what they can accomplish together, not by the number of agreements they endorse.


There is evidence that coordinated action works.

INTERPOL’s Operation Serengeti 2.0

, conducted between June and August 2025, brought together law-enforcement authorities from 18 African countries and the United Kingdom. It resulted in 1,209 arrests, the dismantling of 11,432 malicious infrastructures and the recovery of $97.4 million. Private-sector partners contributed intelligence and technical expertise.


The lesson is not that treaties are unnecessary. Investigations still require lawful powers, admissible evidence and safeguards. Rather, Serengeti demonstrates the value of shared objectives, established channels and institutions equipped to act on intelligence together.


This is where Africa should look beyond calls by some of its leaders for a continental equivalent of

NATO’s Article 5

. On 19 May 2025, Rwandan President Paul Kagame made these remarks in his keynote address at the inaugural

International Security Conference on Africa (ISCA)

, held at the Kigali Convention Centre. Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni has also raised related questions at the

African Defence Chiefs Conference on Military Operations

. While these calls reflect growing interest in collective African security, NATO’s experience offers a more specific lesson for cybersecurity governance.

NATO recognises cyberspace as an operational domain

, and significant cyberattacks may, in certain circumstances, constitute an armed attack. However, invoking collective defence is not automatic: each case is assessed individually by the North Atlantic Council.


For African governments confronting cyber-enabled fraud, ransomware and attacks on public services, the more immediate lesson is not collective retaliation. It is collective preparedness.


Consider

NATO’s annual Locked Shields exercise

, organised by its

Cooperative Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence

. The 2026 exercise brought together approximately 4,000 participants from 41 countries to defend simulated digital systems against complex attacks. Participants tested technical responses while confronting the coordination challenges that emerge during a crisis. The …

author: labor4pal
title: No War Cargo Through Our Ports — No Support for Genocide (Maritime Union of Australia)
content:
A post shared by Maritime Union of Australia. (@maritime_union_australia)

The Maritime Union of Australia expresses its solidarity with dockworkers and port workers internationally who are organising under the slogan “International Day of Action of Dockworkers and Port Workers against war and militarisation” on a 30 October 2026 day of action. The MUA National Council endorse that Branches take measures to support these actions.

The MUA notes that port workers across Europe and the Mediterranean have called and organised coordinated international action against the use of ports and transport infrastructure for war. The MUA opposes loading weapons for war and genocide.

These actions have linked opposition to the genocide of the Palestinian people with opposition to the broader war economy, rearmament, and the transformation of civilian ports into logistical platforms for militarism.

The MUA believes ports belong to the people and to the workers who keep them operating.

They must not be turned into bases or supply chains for imperialist war, occupation or genocide. Public resources should be directed to jobs, communities, safety, wages and social need, not to militarisation, war cargo and the enrichment of arms manufacturers and shipping interests.

No war cargo through our ports.

author: David Swanson
title: Madison for a World BEYOND War Takes Part in National Peace Walk
content:
Chapters, Madison Chapter, Nonviolent Activism, North America

By Madison for a World BEYOND War, October 26, 2026

Madison for a World BEYOND War welcomed the National Peace Walk to the Madison area.

World BEYOND War calls for war abolition: ending all wars. Governments should never engage in the organized mass murder that is war. Conflicts arise among humans and among countries. Negotiation and compromise are the solutions, not killing.

Supermajorities of Americans want Congress to end the Iran war, cut the Pentagon budget, and end forever wars. A new Fox News poll shows 75% of respondents were either “extremely” (42%) or “very” (33%) concerned about the war in Iran, and six in ten voters oppose U.S. military action against Iran. A poll from Rethink/ Brown Costs of War Project found that 59% of Americans believe the Pentagon budget is too high, with 40% saying it’s “much too high.” More details here.

This is a time of unprecedented opportunity to stop the Iran war and more generally US funding for wars. This year, Congress has successfully blocked the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). This is historic. For 64 consecutive years, Congress has approved the NDAA, but this summer it was halted. Congress is using the power of the purse to stop war and preparations for war. Also this year, both houses have introduced war powers legislation to stop the war on Iran.

Madison for a World BEYOND War calls on our government to stop the war on Iran; stop arming Ukraine, Israel and other countries; and close the more than 800 US military bases around the world.

The enemy is not the other side. The enemy is war.

author: Helmut Weiss
title: Genua als Vorbild: Hafenarbeiter:innen weltweit im Widerstand gegen Militarisierung und Waffentransport
content:
Dossier


Der

Streik der Hafenarbeiter von Genua gegen die Waffenlieferungen an die mörderische Saud-Bande und ihren Krieg gegen Jemen

 war eine Art Fanal, dass endlich etwas geschehen muss. Die Aktion der italienischen Docker steht in einer langen Tradition solcher Aktionen, mit denen bereits Waffenlieferungen nach Vietnam verhindert worden waren, aber auch Waffen an die Pinochet-Diktatur zu liefern wurde in Genua verhindert. Eine Tradition, die auch unter heutigen, schwierigen Bedingungen fortgesetzt werde, so sagt es Giacomo Marchetti, der zu den Organisatoren der Aktion gehörte im Gespräch mit David Broder

„We Won’t Load Your Ships of Death – Italian dockers against Saudi war machine“ ursprünglich am 25. Mai 2019 im Jacobin Mag


, jetzt auf Europe Solidaire dokumentiert. Spätestens seit dem Ukraine-Krieg und Nahost-Konflikt hat sich der Wirderstand in den Häfen internalisiert – siehe dazu die Aktionen und

die Liste der Länder-Meldungen/Dossiers

:

Ihr Aufruf zur Eskalation ging aus einem Treffen der Hafenarbeitergewerkschaften hervor, das im Mai in Istanbul stattfand. In der Erklärung wird zudem ​„volle Solidarität mit den Völkern Kubas, Venezuelas und des Sudans“ zum Ausdruck gebracht und erklärt, dass ​„Häfen nicht für den Transport von Waffen, Munition, militärischer Ausrüstung oder Truppen genutzt werden dürfen, die für Kriegsgebiete bestimmt sind.“

(…)


Die Erklärung folgt auf zwei Generalstreiks in Italien im Herbst 2025 aus Solidarität mit den Palästinensern. author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Nobel Peace Laureate Navi Pillay on ICC, Gaza, Rape as War Crime, Her South African Roots & Mandela
content:
We speak with the acclaimed South African human rights lawyer and international jurist Navi Pillay, who was awarded this year’s Nobel Peace Prize. Pillay has been the United Nations high commissioner for human rights and a judge at both the International Criminal Court and at an international tribunal investigating the 1994 genocide in Rwanda. Most recently, she led the U.N. Independent International Commission of Inquiry that concluded Israel had committed genocide in Gaza. Hours after Pillay was announced as winner of the Nobel Prize, the United States imposed sweeping new sanctions against the International Criminal Court.


“It’s extremely shocking to me, totally unacceptable, that the United States administration can today impose sanctions against the International Criminal Court,” says Pillay, speaking to

Democracy Now!

 from The Hague.


Navi Pillay is now 85 years old. She was born into an Indian Tamil family in apartheid South Africa in 1941. The first woman to start a law practice in Natal, South Africa, in 1967, Pillay began her legal career defending anti-apartheid activists including Nelson Mandela, exposing torture, and helping establish key rights for prisoners on Robben Island. Mandela, as president, later appointed Pillay to the High Court of South Africa, making her the first woman of color on that bench.

author: Unknown
title: Mısır da 'Suudi bataklığına' sürükleniyor
content:
Dışişleri Bakanı Hakan Fidan, Mısır Dışişleri Bakanı Bedir Abdulati (solda) ve Suudi Arabistan Dışişleri Bakanı Faysal bin Ferhan 23 Ekim'de İstanbul'da bir araya gelmişlerdi. (Fotoğraf: AA)

Mısır Cumhurbaşkanı Abdulfettah Sisi’nin Ensarullah’a (Husiler) karşı Suudi Arabistan’a her türlü askeri destek vermeye hazır olduklarını açıklaması, haftanın öne çıkan gündemlerinden biri oldu. Kahire, şimdiye kadar Yemen’deki çatışmalardan uzak durmaya ve diplomatik çözüm arayışlarında ara bulucu rolü üstlenmeye öncelik veriyordu. Suudi Arabistan’ın güvenliğini korumak amacıyla askeri destek sağlama yönündeki açıklama ise Mısır’ın bölgesel çatışma karşısındaki tutumunda önemli bir değişime işaret ediyor.

Sisi’nin bu çıkışıyla birlikte Mısır basınında Suudi Arabistan’la tarihsel bağlara, iki ülkenin bölgesel ağırlığına ve Arap dünyasının güvenliği açısından taşıdıkları öneme yapılan vurgular öne çıkıyor. Bu yayınlarda Kahire ile Riyad arasındaki ilişkiler, geçici siyasi çıkarların ötesinde, Arap ulusal güvenliğinin temel dayanaklarından biri olarak sunuluyor. Suudi Arabistan’ın geçmişte Mısır’a sağladığı destek de bu anlatının önemli bir parçasını oluşturuyor.

1973 Arap-İsrail Savaşı sırasında Suudi Arabistan’ın İsrail’i destekleyen ülkelere karşı petrol ambargosu uygulaması ve Mısır’a mali yardım sağlaması, iki ülke arasındaki tarihsel dayanışmanın örnekleri arasında gösteriliyor. Arap Baharı döneminde Kral Abdullah yönetiminin Sisi yönetimine verdiği destek de bu tarihsel bağın devamlılığına kanıt olarak sunuluyor. Macid Münir’in kaleme aldığı ve Mısır ile Suudi Arabistan’ı “doğunun kalesi” olarak nitelendiren yazı da bu söylemin güncel bir örneği. Yazıda iki ülke, bölgesel dengeleri koruyan, Arap ulusal güvenliğini savunan ve daha geniş çaplı bir çatışmayı önleyebilecek iki temel güç olarak tanımlanıyor. Böylece Suudi Arabistan’a destek verilmesi, yalnızca güncel güvenlik kaygılarıyla değil, ortak kader, Arap dayanışması ve bölgesel sorumluluk söylemiyle de meşrulaştırılıyor.

Mısır’ın içinde bulunduğu ekonomik kriz ve Suudi Arabistan’a olan vadesi gelen yüklü borçları tutum değişikliğine gitmesinde önemli unsurlar olarak değerlendiriliyor. Riyad’ın Mısır Merkez Bankasındaki mevduatları ve Kahire’ye sağladığı mali destek, iki ülke arasındaki ilişkinin güvenlik boyutunun ötesine uzandığını gösteriyor. Ancak Mısır’ın tarihsel Yemen tecrübesi, doğrudan bir savaşa katılma konusunda önemli bir çekince oluşturuyor.

1962’de Yemen’e cumhuriyetçileri desteklemek amacıyla asker gönderen Mısır, yıllarca süren çatışmalarda ağır kayıplar verdi. Bazı analistler bu durumu “Yemen sendromu” olarak nitelendiriyor. Aynı dönemde Suudi Arabistan monarşi yanlılarını destekliyordu; dolayısıyla iki ülke Yemen’de karşıt saflarda yer alıyordu. Bugün ise aynı ülkenin güvenliğini savunma gerekçesiyle ortak bir çizgide buluşuyorlar.

Mısır yönetimi bu nedenle askeri desteğin savunma amaçlı olacağı ve Yemen’e yönelik bir saldırıya dönüşmeyeceği mesajını öne çıkarıyor. Mısır Ulusal Savunma Konseyi, Suudi Arabistan’ın güvenliğini, istikrarını, toprak bütünlüğünü ve kutsal mekanlarını korumak için gerekli ve mümkün olan her türlü desteğin sağlanması yönünde karar aldı. Mısır basınında yer alan haberlere göre, olası katkının Suudi Arabistan’a savunma güçleri ve Kızıldeniz’e deniz unsurları gönderilmesiyle sınırlı tutulması seçenekler arasında. Ancak bu çerçevenin fiilen nasıl uygulanacağı ve hangi askeri görevleri kapsayacağı henüz açıklığa kavuşmuş değil. Öte yandan Sisi’nin aynı konuşmada 2030’da yapılacak olan başkanlık seçimlerinde yeniden aday olmayacağını açıklaması da dikkat çekti. Ancak 2017’de üçüncü kez aday olmayacağını söylemesine rağmen 2019’da anayasa değişikliğine giderek 2030’a kadar görevde kalmasının önünü açtı. Üstelik 2030’a daha üç yılı aşkın bir süre var. title: Roma: alcune riflessioni sul corteo di ieri contro carovita ed economia di guerra
content:
Ripubblichiamo il comunicato di

controsapienza e coordinamento studentesco autonomo romano


Ieri mattina il clima a Roma era surreale per giorni non avevano fatto altro che militarizzare sempre di pro la città e cercare di dissuadere le persone dallo scendere in piazza.


Non ci sono riusciti e per tutta la giornata migliaia di giovani hanno attraversato le piazze e le vie chiedendo un futuro migliore. Ieri in piazza non si é scesi per una chiamata di un partito, sindacato o associazione, nella piazza di ieri non vi erano striscioni né bandiere. Ma semplicemente giovani e lavoratrici che si sono rotte il cazzo del carovita e dell’economia di guerra. Si sono rotte il cazzo di vedere le scuole cadere a pezzi di vedere il loro studio all’università per gli sporchi fini delle aziende belliche che hanno le mani sporche di sangue del popolo palestinese, del prezzo della benzina. di salari da fame, affitti alle stelle e di sentire sempre la solita retorica che indica come problema l’immigrato.


Il corteo di ieri é stato vivo, fluido e agile in modo da evitare tutti i vari blocchi che lo stato di polizia ha messo nelle nostre città, evitando più volte la celere centinaia di giovani sono entrate nel Colosseo e poi dopo aver costretto la polizia ad indietreggiare e bloccare la stazione hanno chiesto a gran voce di arrivare a Montecitorio e verso i palazzi del potere. Il corteo dopo numerose ore e deviazioni e stato fermata a largo santa Susanna dalle forze dell’ordine con massiccio utilizzo di manganelli e idrante.


Noi siamo il futuro del paese e non ci fermeremo, siamo giovani e non vogliamo pagare sulla nostra pelle le scelte di politici che non ci rappresentano. Vogliamo essere ascoltate per davvero, ma ogni volta che proviamo a farci sentire la risposta é sempre la repressione.


Ieri é stato solo l’inizio ora sta noi lottare per cambiare questo presente infame in in un futuro migliore.


NOI VOGLIAMO TUTTO. A NOI CI SPETTA TUTTO, NOI CI PRENDEREMO TUTTO.


CI VEDIAMO NELLE SCUOLE, NELLE UNIVERSITA E VENERDI E SABATO


DI NUOVO IN PIAZZA
