title: Sevda Karaca: War policies undermine unity and labour struggles - Part Two
content:
Sevda Karaca, Deputy Chair of the Labour Party (EMEP) and MP for Antep, answered ANF's questions about labour struggles and the struggle for peace. 


Part one of this interview can be read

here

.


Do war, conflict and the resulting militarism push poverty, insecurity and workers' demands out of the public agenda? How exactly are labour struggles weakened during periods when security-driven policies intensify?


The past 40 years have shown us that the effects of war are not confined to areas of armed conflict. War permeates every aspect of social life. Workers' demands for higher wages, the right to strike, women's struggle for equality and people's democratic demands can suddenly be pushed into the background by debates over 'national security', 'the survival of the state' or the 'domestic front'. Rather than answering the questions working people raise about its policies, the government attempts to bring them into line by presenting them with another supposed threat.


This mechanism has very concrete consequences. Strikes are postponed on national security grounds. Trade union organising faces repression. Democratic protests are portrayed as security threats. The conflict of interests between workers and their employers is treated as a security threat, with employers' interests presented as though they were the common interests of society as a whole. Moreover, under conditions of war, those who voice objections can easily be accused of failing to care about their country or their nation. It is workers, working people and poorer sections of society who pay the heaviest price for war. People face both economic devastation and the social consequences of war. Yet they are still expected to make sacrifices. Their questions about why their wages are insufficient, where public resources are being spent and why their rights are being restricted are often drowned out by nationalist rhetoric and growing chauvinism.


Opposition to war and the labour struggle are not two separate areas of struggle. Opposing war cannot be separated from defending workers' livelihoods, their right to strike and their freedom to organise. The political climate created by war restricts working people's ability to defend their rights. At the same time, struggles to protect those rights can become a force against the social consequences of war policies. What matters is that opposition to war must not be confined to a separate sphere, disconnected from the everyday demands of working people.


Opposing war is not a separate task from defending workers' livelihoods, their right to strike and their freedom to organise. On the contrary, to understand why these rights are constantly under threat, we must recognise the social role played by war and militarism.


‘Racism and chauvinism prevent people from coming together’


How can we build a movement for social peace by connecting opposition to war with demands for a higher minimum wage, tax justice, trade union rights and women's right to life?


First of all, we must not reduce peace to politicians sitting around a negotiating table, the silencing of guns or the signing of an agreement. These are, of course, important. But those responsible for war have spent decades using propaganda to legitimise it, dividing peoples and forcing the working class into artificial divisions. Social peace cannot be achieved, nor can peace take root throughout society, simply by bringing the opposing forces to the negotiating table.


War is also a major obstacle to bringing class struggles and broader social movements together. The racism, nationalism and chauvinism being fuelled prevent people, women and young people from uniting around common demands. For example, a worker in the defence industry may be subjected to terrible exploitation, yet that exploitation can be dismissed as an issue because their work is presented as service to the nation.


We must also remember that an atmosphere of war and conflict makes it easier to promote false answers to the question of who is responsible for the poverty, insecurity, discrimination and violence people experience every day. The real causes lie in the existing system and its political and economic representatives. Yet the ruling classes can easily point the finger at migrants, women or an oppressed nation instead.


Another decisive aspect of the struggle to establish lasting peace on a social foundation is discussing what kind of lives people will lead, what rights …

title: Şerda Mazlum: The process requires women's self-defence networks - Part One
content:
Bêrîtan (Gülnaz Karataş), one of the symbolic figures of the Kurdish women's freedom struggle, made history on 25 October 1992 with her self-sacrificing resistance against betrayal and surrender in South Kurdistan. Choosing freedom at the edge of a cliff, Bêrîtan became a symbol not only of resistance but also of women's determination to achieve freedom and continue their struggle.


YJA Star commander Şerda Mazlum Gabar spoke about Bêrîtan's life, personality and resistance, stressing that her legacy of resistance continues to place responsibilities on women today.


Mazlum said discussions in the Peace and Democratic Society Process must give way to concrete steps, pointing out that the freedom of the Kurdish people and women remains under threat. “The greatest and most effective deterrent force is an organised and conscious society,” she said, emphasising the need for women to strengthen their self-defence networks and for society to develop its own forms of organisation.


What were the conditions facing the Kurdish people, Kurdish women and the freedom guerrillas at the time of martyr Bêrîtan's self-sacrificing action? How should her action be understood in the context of those conditions?


Throughout human history, the struggle for human existence has continued despite every hardship, suffering and massacre. It may have been inadequate or incomplete at times, but the struggle to be human and to live a dignified life has always existed. As long as human beings continue to dominate one another, nature and life itself, this struggle will continue. The struggle to reach into the depths of history and recreate love, freedom, justice and labour in their true essence has always faced brutal attacks and attempts to suppress and destroy it. The price of rebelling against slavery and domination in pursuit of freedom has been immense. Across different places and periods, freedom has repeatedly been redefined and given meaning through these sacrifices. The history of every oppressed people, class and gender contains countless extraordinary examples of this. Our own history of freedom also possesses a profound and magnificent legacy of resistance. Among those at the forefront of this legacy is our comrade Bêrîtan, the embodiment of our dignity and freedom. As we mark the 34th anniversary of her martyrdom and enter the 35th year since her death, I commemorate our courageous and brave-hearted commander, comrade Bêrîtan, and, through her, all martyrs of freedom with love and gratitude. I bow respectfully before their memory and renew my promise to fulfil their aspirations for freedom.


Our encounter with freedom as women and Kurds, and our journey towards it, have not been easy. They have been forged through boundless labour, effort and struggle. Comrade Bêrîtan's self-sacrificing action became a breath of life for the Kurdish people and Kurdish women at that time. It revealed the truth that a free life could only be achieved through great resistance. In this sense, her action constitutes one of the fundamental building blocks of the Kurdistan revolution and the morality of freedom that has developed in Kurdistan. 25 October 1992 was the day when the meaninglessness and disgrace of betrayal were answered with the magnificent meaning and sacredness of resistance. It was the will, voice and action of a free and dignified woman against every form of degradation and surrender imposed upon her. Comrade Bêrîtan Hêvî assumed responsibility for a people and their history, acting with an awareness of what it meant to be a pioneer. She reversed the course of surrender and betrayal, halted the downward spiral, rejected every form of degradation imposed upon her and recreated life out of death. She understood what the moment demanded, followed the teachings of freedom and acted in a manner that reflected the spirit of her time.


Historic actions acquire their significance because, at the time and place in which they occur, they address the most vital and pressing problems facing society or offer solutions to them. Not every action marks a turning point or represents a leap into a new stage. Historic actions are distinguished from ordinary actions by the convergence of the right time, the right place and the capacity to bring about meaningful social change. Through these qualities, they become a spirit and a guiding path.


Comrade Bêrîtan and her action embody precisely such a spirit and such a path. There is no one who has not been …

title: Tuğçe Tatari: Peace is an opportunity for the whole country
content:
Thirteen years after her previous visit, journalist Tuğçe Tatari travelled to Qandil once again during a peace process and met with Besê Hozat, Co-Chair of the Executive Council of the Kurdistan Communities Union (KCK).


Tatari spoke to ANF about her impressions of Qandil and the conference that the Women Side by Side group will organise on 31 October and 1 November under the theme “We Stand Side by Side, We Talk About the Future”.


You returned to Qandil after 13 years, once again during a peace process. What changes did you observe over that period? What had remained the same?


If you ask me what remained the same, it was nature. The colours and the light were the same. The natural light in the photographs I took 13 years ago was exactly the same as in the photographs taken this time. Apart from that, 13 years ago, life was lived outdoors. Now, new living spaces have been built inside the mountains, and people live in those spaces. Of course, it is difficult to picture what they are like. Colleagues who had visited before me had told me that they were growing plants inside and so on. But inevitably, you imagine very small, confined spaces and living arrangements that we are not accustomed to. That was not the case at all. They were enormous living spaces.


I was able to visit two communes: a press commune and a cultural commune. Through engineering work, they have created large living spaces inside the mountains, without windows. There are meeting areas, dining areas, kitchens, accommodation sections and rooms. That was undoubtedly the biggest change. On my previous visit, we had stayed outdoors, and I had slept in a tent. This time, they gave us one of the rooms inside, and we stayed there. That was quite a difference. In fact, it was a major change for me.


At the same time, although these large living spaces have been established, the emotional damage caused by the past decade of war, or rather, the period of conflict, and the sense of loss it has left behind were evident in almost every conversation. Because I stayed for several days, I had the opportunity to speak with many guerrillas. Everyone had stories marked by greater sadness. Most of their questions concerned the possibility of returning: ‘What will happen if we return?’, ‘Is Turkey ready for us to come back?’, ‘How do you see things?’ In fact, just as we are all watching the process with curiosity, wondering whether anything will happen, whether there will be developments and where the process will lead, they too are waiting there to see how it unfolds.


What was the mood among the guerrillas, as far as you could observe during your visit?


I cannot say there was a sense of hopelessness. It would be more accurate to say that the lack of concrete steps from Turkey was raising questions in their minds. They follow current developments closely, of course, through television, newspapers and other sources. They pay particular attention to statements coming from Turkey, especially those made on behalf of the state. In fact, the process does not seem to be moving forward at the moment. So, rather than expressing their own views, they want to hear what is happening here. As I said, they ask questions such as: ‘How is the process being viewed?’, ‘Why is there such difficulty in building public support for the process?’, ‘Looking at things from Turkey, do you see any possibility of the process succeeding?’ Beyond these questions, they are naturally wondering whether they will ever return. We said goodbye to one another with the thought that perhaps our next meeting would take place in Diyarbakır (Amed), Istanbul or Ankara.


In fact, like everyone else in Turkey, they are waiting to see what happens. But as people directly affected by the issue, whose futures depend to some extent on this process, their interest is naturally much more immediate. That applies to those in Europe, those in prison and those in Qandil. They are all directly concerned with the outcome. I would therefore say that their desire to understand what is happening in Turkey is much stronger.


What was the conviction that, as you mentioned in your article, became stronger during your time in Qandil? Could you elaborate on that?


Of course, I haven't written about Qandil itself yet. I've written about my interview with Besê Hozat. There is actually a great deal I want to write about Qandil. As I said, there were so many people to speak to, so much time for conversations, so many …

title: Kurdish and Arab guerrillas pay tribute to commander Bêrîtan, a symbol of freedom for all women
content:
Bêrîtan (Gülnaz Karataş), one of the pioneering commanders of the women’s freedom struggle, was commemorated by Kurdish and Arab women guerrillas on the anniversary of her martyrdom. Drawing attention to Bêrîtan’s spiritual, military, and ideological role, the women guerrillas emphasized that her resistance occupies a historic place in the women’s freedom struggle.


The guerrillas stated that Bêrîtan’s path of resistance has shown all women in the Middle East the way to freedom, adding that her struggle continues to serve as a source of willpower, strength, and inspiration for women today.


Commander Bêrîtan is a symbol of resistance and freedom for all women


Guerrilla Bişenk Brûsk drew attention to the historical impact of Bêrîtan’s actions, stating that her resistance paved the way for the development of women’s military organization.


 


Guerrilla Brûsk said: “Martyr Bêrîtan represents willpower, strength, and morale for us. She was a woman who turned toward her own essence and refused to surrender to the enemy in the face of oppression and hardship. Following her sacrificial act, a women’s military organization developed. She showed us the way to understand both our own reality and the reality of the enemy.”


Bişenk Brûsk also stated that Bêrîtan’s modest and self-sacrificing character continues to be a source of energy and freedom for all her comrades.


Commander Bêrîtan, an inspiration for Arab women


Guerrilla Asya Amed, who is of Arab origin, stated that Bêrîtan’s stance transcended national boundaries and had also become a source of inspiration for Arab women.


 


Recalling how deeply she was moved when she watched a film about Bêrîtan’s life for the first time, Asya Amed said that Bêrîtan’s courage gives women hope and confidence.


Guerrilla Amed said: “When I watched the film about martyr Bêrîtan for the first time, I was deeply moved. She is a symbol of freedom not only for Kurdish women, but for all women. Her courage gives us hope and confidence. Her fearless stance shows that women can stand against obstacles under any circumstances.”


Asya Amed stated that, as an Arab guerrilla, she had pledged to uphold and follow Bêrîtan’s path of resistance and philosophy to the very end.

title: All power to the people is something we build
content:
General Strike U.S. describes a phase where a movement has built something beyond capitalism, is ready to withdraw, is ready to sustain that withdrawal and has material power behind it. We don't disappear after disruption, the speaker says. We govern what we build, a dual and contending power becoming real power. All power to the people is something actually being built and committed to.

author: radical.guide
title: Power is the capacity to act
content:
General Strike U.S. and The Panther Party defines power as something you can hold: the ability to define a phenomenon and make it act in the desired manner. Political power backed by the ability to enact a political consequence is real, and any proclamation without that backing is words on paper. The aim is the capacity of the people to affect their material conditions directly, to protect ourselves and make the things we need.

title: Joyeux anniversaire à l'AIF
content:
Depuis 2021, au Myanmar, l'armée birmane a de nouveau repris le pouvoir par un coup d'État.


Ancienne colonie britannique, le pays a ensuite essuyé plusieurs décennies de contrôle par l'armée birmane (Tatmadaw) avant d'avoir un début de transition démocratique en 2015. Cette séquence démocratique, loin d'être parfaite, comme tous les régimes politiques, a vite été balayée par la reprise du pouvoir par l'armée officielle du Myanmar.


Depuis 5 ans donc, des groupes armés rebelles s'organisent et font face à cette hégémonie. Ils sont nombreux et tentent de faire front commun contre la Tatmadaw et ses alliées (Chine et Russie).


La semaine dernière on célébrait l'anniversaire de l'

AIF

 (Front internationaliste antifasciste)

 qui a été fondé en octobre 2024 dans un village à la périphérie de la ville de Falam au Myanmar, alors que des internationalistes aux côtés de révolutionnaires locaux se préparaient à ce qui allait devenir la bataille de cinq mois pour libérer Falam.


L'

AIF

 combat dans l'état de

CHIN

, dans la partie ouest du Myanmar, et aux côtés de groupes armés camarades. L'

AIF

 participe à la formation de camarades venus de différentes région du pays, mais aussi à des internationalistes venus du monde entier.


En unissant nos luttes, nous renforçons le front toujours plus large contre le fascisme.


La lutte au Myanmar s'inscrit dans une révolution plus globale des peuples pour leur autodétermination.


Et ce combat est plus que présent au cœur de l'internationalisme, emplis d'enjeux économiques et de jeux d'alliances notamment avec la chine : vente d'armes, nouvelles routes et corridor économiques, Etc.

author: Unknown
title: Olive groves of locals seized in Afrin
content:
According to local sources, the Rajo Economic Office seized an olive grove belonging to an 80-year-old woman named Fidan Bilal.


On October 22, the Rajo Economic Office reportedly disregarded the law by bringing workers to Fidan Bilal’s grove and having them harvest the olives for its own benefit.


In the Bilbil district, the Bilbil Economic Office seized resident Ahmed Mamo’s olive grove in the village of Qestel and harvested 28 sacks of olives.


The Bilbil Economic Office stated that the regional director had ordered the seizure of Ahmed Mamo’s grove and prohibited him from harvesting his own olives.


Ahmed Mamo still has 140 olive trees that have yet to be harvested.

title: Ephéméride des luttes : 25 octobre
content:
L'éphéméride des luttes du 25 octobre sert à ne pas oublier nos camarades, les luttes qui ont été menées, parce que celles qui vivent aujourd'hui sont aussi faites de la même matière, de celle qui pousse à la révolte.


1806 :

 Naissance à Bayreuth en Bavière de Max Stirner, théoricien de l'individualisme anarchiste.


1878 :

 En Espagne, l'anarchiste Juan Oliva Moncasi tente d'abattre le roi d'Espagne Alphonse XII.


1884 :

 A Paris, parution du journal '

Terre et Liberté

'.


1920 :

 Dans la prison de Brixton en Angleterre, l'Irlandais du Nord Terence MacSwiney meurt au terme de 74 jours de grève de la faim.


1928 :

 A Montevideo (Uruguay), "

les anarchistes catalans, Jaime Tadeo Peña, Agustin Garcia Capdevilla, Pedro Boadas Rivas et des argentins Antonio et Vicente Moretti braquent le bureau de change Messina. Ils s'emparent d'un butin de 4 000 pesos mais dans la violence de l'attaque tuent trois personnes dont le directeur de l'agence, un employé et un chauffeur de taxi. La fusillade nourrie blesse également trois autres personnes et mobilise alors la police uruguayenne sur la piste des anarchistes qui seront arrêtés le 9 novembre

".


Repris de l'éphéméride anarchiste (lien plus bas)


1956 :

 A Budapest, on est encore dans la révolution et de grandes émeutes sont en cours contre l'entrée des chars soviétiques dans la ville.


1977 :

 - En Allemagne, Irmgard Moeller, la seule survivante des quatre prisonnier-e-s de la RAF en prison à Stammheim, est de nouveau capable de parler. Elle dit avoir été éveillée jusqu'à tard dans la nuit, avoir entendu deux coups de feu puis s'être évanouie et avoir été traînée en-dehors de sa cellule, où elle s'est réveillée couverte de sang. Elle écarte toute hypothèse de suicide.


 A Rome, trois attentats sont commis contre des concessionnaires automobiles allemands.


Par ailleurs, deux molotov sont lancés sur un magasin Volkswagen en réaction à la mort de plusieurs membres de la Fraction Armée Rouge dans les prisons allemandes quelques jours plus tôt.

 A Turin, les Brigades Rouges tirent six coups de feu dans les jambes du conseiller de la Démocratie Chrétienne (DC, le parti au pouvoir depuis l'après-guerre) Antonio Cocozzello.

 A Trento, une charge de dynamite explose contre un concessionnaire Volkswagen et deux cocktails molotov sont lancés dans le jardin du directeur de l'entreprise allemande Brinkmann.

 A Potenza, la voiture du maire et la maison d'un conseiller régional (tous les deux appartenant à la DC) sont attaquées au molotov.


2016 :

 A Limoges, une voiture de police

est incendiée

 à deux ans de la mort de Rémi Fraisse et en soutien aux proches d'Adama Traoré.

author: Μπάμπης Μπίκας
title: Οι φοιτητές κονταροχτυπούν στα ίσα (και) εκλογικά το καθεστώς Βούτσιτς
content:
Το κίνημα που αναπτύχθηκε στη Σερβία τα δύο τελευταία χρόνια, μετά την κατάρρευση του στεγάστρου του ανακαινισμένου σιδηροδρομικού σταθμού στο Νόβι Σαντ που σκότωσε 16 ανθρώπους και πυροδότησε δυναμικές και μαζικές αντιδράσεις, αποτέλεσε τον καταλύτη για τη διεύρυνση των διαδηλώσεων κατά της κυβέρνησης αλλά και την ευρύτερη αμφισβήτηση της λειτουργίας του κράτους. Με βασικά αιτήματα για τη διαφθορά, τη διαφάνεια, τις δημόσιες υπηρεσίες και τη μαφιόζικη λειτουργία του καθεστώτος Βούτσιτς. Εκείνο το κίνημα με κορμό τους φοιτητές και τις καταλήψεις στα πανεπιστήμια, στην αρχή του είχε χαρακτηριστικά οριζόντιας λειτουργίας και στόχευση ακόμη και μια νέα συντακτική συνέλευση, αποφάσισε τελικά να κινηθεί στη λογική της κυβερνησιμότητας με ρεφορμιστικά και εθνικά χαρακτηριστικά. Κατεβαίνει στις εκλογές με τη “Φοιτητική Λίστα – Οι Φοιτητές Νικούν”.


Ο μέχρι πρότινος πρόεδρος Αλεξάντερ Βούτσιτς, που δεν είχε δικαίωμα για νέα θητεία,  παραιτήθηκε για να διεκδικήσει τη συνέχεια της εξουσίας του μέσω της πρωθυπουργίας. Μόνο που δεν ανέμενε ότι ο εκλογικός συνδυασμός που κατέθεσαν οι φοιτητές θα αναδεικνυόταν στον βασικό αντίπαλό του σε αυτές τις εκλογές που διεξάγονται σήμερα στη Σερβία. Οι δημοσκοπήσεις μάλιστα φέρνουν τη «Φοιτητική Λίστα – Οι Φοιτητές Νικούν» που κατεβαίνει στην εκλογική αναμέτρηση να αναμετράται στα ίσα με την κυβερνητική «Ενωμένη Σερβία», με αμφότερους να κυμαίνονται στο συν/πλην 45%.


Στην τελική τους συγκέντρωση στη Σλάβια του Βελιγραδίου συμμετείχαν πάνω από 150.000 πολίτες και κύριο σύνθημα: Σερβία ή μαφία! Οι φοιτητές πλέον διεκδικούν την εξουσία. Αλλά κανένανς από αυτούς δεν συμμετέχει στους συνδυασμούς για την ανάδειξη των νέων 250 βουλευτών. Αποφάσισαν αυτό και απευθύνθηκαν σε προσωπικότητες του ακαδημαϊκού χώρου, καλλιτέχνες, αθλητές, την κοινωνία των πολιτών.


Το στρατόπεδο του Βούτσιτς, που κυριαρχεί στην πολιτική ζωή από το 2012, και ο προπαγανδιστικός μηχανισμός του κατηγορεί τη Φοιτητική Λίστα ότι κινείται ως όργανο ξένων μυστικών υπηρεσιών με στόχο την ανατροπή του και την αποσταθεροποίηση της χώρας, που σχοινοβατεί γεωπολιτικά μεταξύ Ρωσίας, ΕΕ, ΗΠΑ. Μάλιστα στη φαρέτρα χρησιμοποιείται ακόμη και το ζήτημα του Κοσόβου για να χτυπήσουν τον αντιπολιτευόμενο συνδυασμό.


Η πόλωση που καταγράφηκε, η χρησιμοποίηση του κρατικού μηχανισμού και του προπαγανδιστικού συστημικού μιντιακού οπλοστασίου, προκάλεσαν πλήθος καταγγελιών για τις συνθήκες της προεκλογικής εκστρατείας. Πέραν των διαφόρων διεθνών παρατηρητών, 24 οργανώσεις της κοινωνίας των πολιτών προειδοποίησαν ότι δεν πληρούνται οι απαραίτητες προϋποθέσεις για τη διεξαγωγή «ελεύθερων και δίκαιων εκλογών». Η έντονη πόλωση αφήνει ερωτηματικά ακόμη και για την αποδοχή ή μη ενός εκλογικού αποτελέσματος από την πλευρά του καθεστώτος Βούτσιτς.


ΡΕΠΟΡΤΑΖ + ΦΩΤΟ ΠΡΟΕΚΛΟΓΙΚΗΣ ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗΣ ΤΗΣ «ΦΟΙΤΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΛΙΣΤΑΣ – ΟΙ ΦΟΙΤΗΤΕΣ ΝΙΚΟΥΝ» ΑΠΌ ΤΟ Ν1


Ποτάμια ανθρώπων στη Σλάβια στην τελική συσυγκέντρωση της Φοιτητικής Λίστας: «Θυμίζει 15 Μαρτίου και μυρίζει ελευθερία»


Η «Φοιτητική Λίστα – Οι Φοιτητές Νικούν» διοργάνωσε την τελευταία προεκλογική συγκέντρωση πριν από τις έκτακτες βουλευτικές εκλογές την Κυριακή 25 Οκτωβρίου στην πλατεία Σλάβια στο Βελιγράδι. Στο δρόμο προς τη Σλάβια, ξεκίνησαν οργανωμένοι σε έξι πορείες από διαφορετικά μέρη της πόλης.


Οι υποψήφιοι της «Φοιτητικής Λίστας – Οι Φοιτητές Νικούν» και οι φοιτητές που τους υποστηρίζουν δήλωσαν στην τελική συγκέντρωση ότι οι εκλογές της Κυριακής δεν είναι μεταξύ 18 συνδυασμών, αλλά μεταξύ δύο αρχών και δύο οραμάτων – «Σερβία ή μαφία· ελευθερία ή δουλεία· ευημερία ή παρακμή».


Ατελείωτες φάλαγγες πολιτών κατευθύνθηκαν προς τη Σλάβια από έξι κατευθύνσεις, από το Νόβι Βελιγράδι, από το Ζέμουν από την Τσουκαρίτσα, ενώ λίγο αργότερα, φάλαγγες ξεκίνησαν επίσης από την Πλατεία Φοιτητών, από το κτίριο της Τεχνικής Σχολής στη Λεωφόρο Κράλιε Αλεξάνδρα, καθώς και από την Αυτοκομάντα.


Κατά τη διάρκεια της ημέρας οργανώθηκαν αρκετές αυτοκινητοπομπές από διάφορα μέρη της Σερβίας.


Στο τέλος της συνάντησης, όλοι οι υποψήφιοι της Φοιτητικής Λίστας κατέβηκαν από τη σκηνή ανάμεσα στους πολίτες, παρατάχθηκαν σε κύκλο γύρω από το σιντριβάνι στη Σλάβια, κρατώντας ψηλά το Σύνταγμα της Σερβίας.


Οι υποψήφιοι βουλευτές της Φοιτητικής Λίστας μίλησαν για το πώς θα μοιάζει η Σερβία από τις 26 Οκτωβρίου, την επόμενη μέρα των εκλογών, η οποία περιλαμβάνει, μεταξύ άλλων, μια απελευθερωμένη δικαστική εξουσία και εισαγγελία, αλλά και εκπαίδευση και υγειονομική περίθαλψη εξίσου προσβάσιμες σε όλους.

title: Meteoroloji'den sağanak uyarısı: Bazı bölgelerde yağış, iç kesimlerde sis bekleniyor
content:
Meteoroloji Genel Müdürlüğü (MGM) tarafından yayımlanan son tahmin raporuna göre, yurt genelinde havanın parçalı ve yer yer çok bulutlu geçeceği tahmin ediliyor.

Ülkenin batı kıyılarında ve doğu kesimlerinde yağış beklenirken, sabah ve gece saatlerinde iç bölgelerde pus ve sis etkili olacak.

Doğu Anadolu’nun doğusu ile Muğla ve Aydın’ın kıyı kesimleri, Bingöl ve Mardin çevrelerinde sağanak ve gök gürültülü sağanak yağış geçişleri bekleniyor.

Sabah ve gece saatlerinde Marmara, İç Ege, Göller Yöresi, Batı Karadeniz’in iç kesimleri ile Orta Karadeniz genelinde pus ve yer yer sis olayı öngörülüyor. Görüş mesafesinde düşüş yaşanabilecek bu bölgelerde sürücülerin dikkatli olması isteniyor.

Sıcaklıkların batı kesimlerde mevsim normalleri civarında, iç ve doğu bölgelerde ise normallerin yer yer üzerinde seyretmeye devam edeceği tahmin ediliyor.

Rüzgarın genellikle kuzeyli, güney ve doğu kesimlerde ise güneyli yönlerden hafif, ara sıra orta kuvvette esmesi bekleniyor.

author: Kodao Productions
title: A hollow victory: On the SC decision declaring parts of the 2024-2026 budgets unconstitutional
content:
By

Atty. Ephraim B. Cortez


In a recent decision, the Supreme Court declared the Unprogrammed Appropriation in the 2024, 2025, and 2026 General Appropriations Acts (GAA) unconstitutional. The Court found that Congress and the Bicameral Conference Committee committed grave abuse of discretion amounting to a lack or excess of jurisdiction for the following reasons:


The grant of authority to avail of the Unprogrammed Appropriation by the mere existence of any excess revenues from a specific source without considering the aggregate amount of revenue generated from all other sources is unconstitutional.


The pertinent provision of the GAA providing the condition for availment states:


“1. Availment of the Unprogrammed Appropriations. The amounts authorized herein for purpose Nos. 2-4,6, and 9-10 may be used when any of the following exists:


“a. Excess revenue collections in any of the identified non-tax revenue sources from its corresponding revenue collection target, as reflected in the Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing (BESF);


“b. New revenue collections or those arising from new tax or non-tax sources which are not part of, nor included in, the original revenue sources reflected in the BESF;


“c. Approved loans for foreign-assisted projects.


As written, any excess revenue triggers the availment of the Unprogrammed Appropriations. However, in Araullo v. Aquino III, the Supreme Court held that Unprogrammed Appropriations may be used only after aggregate revenue collections from all sources exceed the projections in the BESF. They are not intended to be activated “when individual revenue sources exceed their targets or when new revenue sources become available.”


The Supreme Court emphasized that Unprogrammed Appropriations serve as standby authority and should be “deficit neutral.” Therefore, they may be used only after the budgetary deficit for Programmed Appropriations has been addressed.


They gave the executive department the discretion to allocate excess revenues to Unprogrammed Appropriation without providing sufficient standards to limit the exercise of such discretion.


Under the GAA, the availment of the Unprogrammed Appropriation is triggered by the mere existence of excess in revenue collections in any of the “non-tax revenue collection target” as indicated in the Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing (BESF), or revenue collections in any from new tax or non-taxes which are not included in the sources of revenues under the BESF. It is apparent from the language of the provision that once any of the two conditions exist, the executive department is given the authority and the discretion to determine how to allocate excess revenues for the implementation of the Unprogrammed Appropriations.


As explained by Supreme Court, we are running on an unbalanced budget, meaning the projected expenditures are usually in excess of the projected revenues. As such, if there are revenues generated in excess of the projected revenues, the same should be allocated to fill the revenue deficit for the Programmed Appropriations. The Unprogrammed Appropriations are merely a standby authority which cannot be prioritized over that of the Programmed Appropriations.


Under the subject GAAs, the executive department is given the discretion to prioritize Unprogrammed Appropriations over that of the Programmed Appropriations in the allocation of excess revenues.


Congress did not define the parameters and provide for sufficient standards on how excess revenues should be allocated for Unprogrammed Appropriations. This is tantamount to an undue delegation of power, and the President is given the unbridled discretion to allocate such excess revenues.


They increased the total national budget or the total appropriations proposed by the President in violation of the provisions of Art. VI, Sec. 25 (1) of the 1987 Constitution.


The Supreme Court clarified that “Appropriations” in contemplation of Sec. 29, (1), Art. VI of the 1987 Constitution refers to any legislated allocation of a “determinate or determinable amount of money” for a “particular public purpose.” It covers both “programmed” and “unprogrammed appropriations which are both subject to the same constitutional standards and limitations. As such, the limitation imposed by Art. VI, Sec. 25 (1) of the 1987 is likewise applicable to Unprogrammed Appropriations.

author: Brian Hioe
title: Political Parties Spar Over Taiwan’s Demographic Woes
content:
THE KMT HAS hit out at the DPP’s failure to correct Taiwan’s demographic woes, crticizing the decline in the national population. According to the National Development Council, Taiwan’s population is expected to fall below 20 million by 2045. Taiwan’s population is expected to halve by 2075.

Specifically, the KMT has made a new savings plan it proposed that the DPP rejected, the Taiwan Youth Development and Future Account Act, as proof that the DPP does not care about the issue. The act would have allocated an “Education and Development Account” and “Taiwan Future Account” to each child, the former of which would be able to be used at any time, and the latter of which would be accessible at age 18. 60,000 NT would be provided to each child per year under the proposal. The KMT has also hit out at the inability of the government to construct more social housing.

Nevertheless, one notes that the DPP rejected the Taiwan Youth Development and Future Account Act on the basis that it, in allowing for corporate sponsors, it could increase the gaps in inequality. The DPP has instead proposed a similar proposal that would also allow for 60,000 NT to be allocated to each child annually.

Otherwise, one notes that the DPP plans to increase subsidies for housing, education, and childcare, with particular efforts to spread costs between the government and families in childcare. Likewise, the DPP has stated that it intends to extend the amount of parental leave that can be subsidized to nine months, extend maternity leave to 12 weeks, extend marriage leave to 14 days, and increase the amount of leave that a husband can take to accompany his spouse to prenatal examinations to 14 days.

More generally, the approach would be to increase existing subsidies while extending existing leave programs. Nevertheless, one imagines that the KMT would have more or less adopted the same approach if it were in power–there is little difference between the two major parties when it comes to the political imagination of how to solve Taiwan’s declining birthrate.

Indeed, more generally, both major parties are unwilling to make the larger systematic changes that would allow for such issues to be solved. For example, there continues to be widespread reluctance to open up Taiwanese society to immigrants, with Taiwan only allowing blue-collar migrant workers to come here as individuals, without their families, and also not allowing blue-collar migrant workers to stay in Taiwan beyond twelve or fourteen years.

To this extent, Taiwan’s issues with a declining birthrate often stem from social pressures on newly expectant parents–especially mothers–issues that cannot be solved through simply throwing money at the issue. In this sense, Taiwan’s declining birthrate is likely only to be a political issue used by both sides to hit out at each other, rather than that either side of the political aisle would seriously consider solutions.

author: Julie Zenderoudi
title: New Study Finds EPA May Be Vastly Underreporting PFAS Levels in Drinking Water
content:
The researchers found the Environmental Protection Agency’s minimum reporting levels masked widespread contamination.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

US drinking water could contain double the PFAS levels currently reported by regulators, according to a new study from Texas Christian University.

The study, published in Cell Reports Sustainability, used computer modeling to estimate that the latest reports from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) capture only 44% of the average combined concentration of 25 polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in US water systems.

PFAS, also known as “forever chemicals,” are known to persist in the environment and are linked to some cancers, high cholesterol, reproductive issues, and other health problems.

Researchers analyzed more than 1.8 million PFAS measurement records from the EPA’s January 2026 release of monitoring data from water systems across the country. They found most individual PFAS test results in the dataset fall below the EPA’s minimum reporting levels (MRLs).

These data points are often treated as zero when agencies and researchers summarize average PFAS levels in drinking water.

The authors found that 98% of PFAS test results were below the MRL. The MRL generally means a concentration that most laboratories can reliably measure and report. However, the study’s authors argue that this doesn’t mean that the water tested is PFAS-free or that it’s safe.

“Below the reporting limit does not mean zero. Our study shows why that distinction matters when summarizing PFAS concentrations,” said lead author Gehendra Kharel, associate professor of environmental and geological sciences at Texas Christian University.

Kharel and his team used computer models applied to data from the EPA’s Fifth Unregulated Contaminant Monitoring Rule (UCMR 5), a nationwide program that requires public water systems to test drinking water for specific PFAS. They used this dataset to estimate possible concentrations for PFAS records listed below the EPA’s MRL.

They averaged hundreds of data points to come up with an estimate, performing this calculation for all 25 PFAS that had been detected at least once in the EPA’s dataset.

Under the study’s primary statistical model, they found that treating below-limit results as zero captured only 44% of the average combined concentration of the 25 PFAS monitored across 9,991 community water systems.

Jesse Goodrich, assistant professor in the division of environmental health at the University of Southern California, said that while municipal drinking water data explains why certain people have elevated chemical levels, these findings clarify why so many Americans, regardless of location or water source, have detectable PFAS in their blood.

“People traditionally have thought that drinking water is a large source of exposure to different PFAS compounds. And so when you look at the UCMR results, you see a lot of zeros, and that is hard to reconcile based on the human biomonitoring studies, where you see that everyone is actually exposed,” Goodrich said.

The results of this study are model-generated predictions rather than measurements of actual concentrations. However, Goodrich believes the results explain how trace contamination builds up.

“There’s very low levels of PFAS in drinking water, and over time, since compounds have such a long half life, that can add up to measurable, kind of ubiquitous exposure in the population,” Goodrich said.

Kharel believes the study could help provide a more complete picture of PFAS levels in US drinking water and improve how environmental monitoring data are interpreted, bridging the gap between official estimates and the actual level of chemicals in our water.

Alissa Cordner, co-director of the PFAS Project Lab at Northeastern University, said the EPA takes a more conservative approach by treating unmeasurable chemical samples as zero, which results in the lowest possible contamination estimates.

Cordner argues scientists can use better methods. Instead of assuming zero, researchers often estimate low-level presence by dividing the lab’s detection limit by either two or the square root of two.

“Either of those approaches are going to give you a less conservative and potentially more environmentally relevant measure of what’s actually going on in these samples,” she said.

author: Jason Pramas
title: The Entire Journalism Industry Is on a Collision Course With AI
content:
News publishers either fight tech oligarchs or we lose the Fourth Estate.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

While it is not yet possible to say that the group of technologies currently called “AI” is harmful to literally everyone, that tech is already harming large numbers of people in many different ways: jeopardizing their jobs, health, privacy, and lived environment. And I can say with certainty that the way these technologies are being built, deployed, and used has been extremely harmful to the journalism industry in general and to small news outlets in particular.

It is for that reason that my organization, the Boston Institute for Nonprofit Journalism, recently joined with 59 other publishers to file a mass-action lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft. Together, this group of plaintiffs, represented by the mission-driven law firm Platkin LLP, controls more than 500 news outlets large and small across the United States.

Our main complaint is that OpenAI and Microsoft took our articles without asking our permission and definitely without providing us payment of any kind, in violation of well-established copyright law, in order to build the large-language models that are the core of their AI businesses.

This is only one type of damage that the AI giants in question have inflicted on news outlets all over the U.S. and the world. And the exposure for these companies due to that damage is absolutely huge when one combines the potential amount that our lawsuit could cost OpenAI and Microsoft with the potential amount similar lawsuits could cost those defendants — as well as the truly massive New York Times suit against the same companies on the same grounds that has been wending its way through the legal system for three years. Which, clearly, is why we are suing on those grounds.

But there are other ways the vast corporations that make up the nascent AI industry have harmed news organizations. Perhaps the worst of those is that the volume of traffic to news outlets from web search has been dropping since the AI boom began a few years ago (a dilemma that Truthout leaders have ably elucidated in two recent commentaries). We all rely upon that traffic for maintaining and, more importantly, growing our audiences over time. Audiences translate to revenue for news publications as with every other business on the web, be that revenue donations for nonprofit news groups or advertising for both nonprofit and commercial ones.

According to a January 2026 report by the University of Oxford’s Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism that used a survey “drawn from a strategic sample of 280 digital leaders from 51 countries and territories” to look at major threats faced this year by the news industry, “Aggregate data, sourced from the analytics company Chartbeat for this report, show that Google traffic from organic search to over 2,500 sites was down by a third (33%) globally between Nov 2024 and Nov 2025 and by 38% in the United States, but it is not clear how much of this is down to AI overviews.”

The news “editors, CEOs, and digital executives” surveyed for the Reuters Institute report forecast another 43 percent drop in organic search traffic to news sites this year, but we’ll have to wait until the next report to see how accurate that prediction was.

“In the past year, 170 newspapers have closed or merged, at a rate of nearly three a week, and many of these were the last remaining source of original news in their communities.”

And the fact that the study did not determine how much of that drop was due to AI search summaries does not mean that effect was insignificant. The Pew Research Center tracked 68,879 real Google searches by 900 U.S. adults in March 2025 and compared what happened when an AI search summary box (called “AI Overview” on Google) appeared on top of a search results page versus when it didn’t. The percentage that clicked through to a non-Google website link when there was no AI Overview box on top of the search results page was 15 percent. The percentage when there was an AI Overview box on top of the search results page was 8 percent. Meaning that almost half the people who would normally click through to a non-Google website link from Google search did not do so when an AI Overview box was present on top of a Google search results page.

author: Lauren Rankin
title: Abortion Rights Are on the Ballot in 4 States in the 2026 Midterms
content:
Voters in Missouri, Idaho, Virginia, and Nevada will decide the fate of abortion rights in their states.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Abortion is once again on the ballot. While the fate of the U.S. Senate and the U.S. House both hang in the balance, the Trump administration can still wreak havoc on abortion rights with or without congressional approval, including a backdoor ban on medication abortion. That’s why state-level measures on abortion in the 2026 midterms elections will be so consequential in the fight for reproductive rights.

This November, voters will decide the fate of abortion rights in four states. Three of those states — Idaho, Nevada, and Virginia — have initiatives that would protect abortion rights in the state. Missouri has an amendment on the ballot that undoes the results of the referendum two years ago, in which voters approved a measure to enshrine reproductive freedom in the state constitution.

Here’s a closer look at the stakes for abortion rights in each of those four states:

If you thought Missouri just did this, you’re not wrong. After Roe v. Wade was struck down in 2022, Missouri became the first state to enact a total abortion ban, without exceptions for rape or incest. But Missourians weren’t okay with that. In the 2024 general election, despite overwhelmingly going for Trump, Missouri voted to enshrine the right to abortion in the state constitution, becoming the first state to overturn an abortion ban by the direct vote of the people. That should have been the end of it — abortion was a protected right that could not be infringed by lawmakers in the state. Abortion providers and advocates began challenging the state’s restrictions in court, including an essential ban on providing medication abortion, and won.

But far right leaders like the Attorney General Catherine Hanaway and the Republicans in the Missouri state legislature have simply refused to accept defeat. Now, they’ve enjoined a near-total abortion ban (this one does contain exceptions for rape and incest, as well as fetal anomalies) with a ban on gender-affirming care for minors. Nevermind that gender-affirming care for minors is already banned in Missouri. This is a nakedly political attempt to use transphobic backlash to undo the will of the people and sneak in a ban on abortion.

If Missouri voters approve Amendment 3, nearly all abortions and gender-affirming care for minors will be banned, and a host of anti-abortion measures will also become law, including a ban on public funding for abortion and TRAP (Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers) laws that are designed to make it more difficult for reproductive health clinics to operate.

Idaho has had a total abortion ban in effect since August of 2022, and it has had devastating consequences for the state. After its draconian abortion ban went into effect, the state lost approximately 35 percent of its practicing obstetricians, and at least three rural hospitals have shuttered their labor and delivery departments as a result. This last left Idahoans with an acute lack of access to reproductive health care, and left the remaining OBGYNs in the state overwhelmed with an increased patient load. The results are catastrophically long wait times — in Boise, it can take up to nine months to secure an appointment for an annual exam.

With Proposition 1 on their midterm ballot, Idaho voters now have a chance to reverse some of that harm. This ballot initiative would establish a fundamental right to reproductive freedom and privacy in the state. If voters approve this initiative, it would give providers and advocates an avenue to challenge the state’s total abortion ban in court and potentially legalize abortion services.

Voters in these four states will have a rare opportunity to directly vote on the status of bodily autonomy, and the results could affect us all.

While Proposition 1 is a step in the right direction, it wouldn’t carry the same weight as a constitutional amendment. Instead of codifying abortion as an inherent right in the state’s constitution, Proposition 1 would instead create a “statutory right” to abortion. Statutory rights are easier to change than constitutional rights and remain subordinate to the constitution — they can be challenged in court with a lower threshold than a constitutional amendment. title: Fransa’da eylemler sürüyor: Gündüz yüz binler yürüdü akşam polis saldırdı
content:
Fransa’da son haftalarda hayat pahalılığına, ücretlerin yetersizliğine ve kamu hizmetlerindeki sorunlara karşı büyüyen protestolar, 24 Ekim Cumartesi günü de farklı kentlerde sürdü. Protestolara yüz binlerce kişi katılırken akşam saatlerinde polis saldırısı başladı.

content:
Εξάρχεια: “Αν δεν αντισταθούμε σε λόφους και πλατείες” – Πορεία 17 Οκτώβρη 2026 (Βίντεο από το Λόφο του Στρέφη)


Εξάρχεια: (17/10/2026), Έπειτα από κάλεσμα της Ανοιχτής Συνέλευσης για την υπεράσπιση του Λόφου του

Στρέφη

, ο κόσμος της γειτονιάς συγκεντρώθηκε στο «μπασκετάκι» και βγήκε ξανά στους δρόμους, απαντώντας δυναμικά στη 19μηνη αστυνομική κατοχή, τους τραμπουκισμούς, τα φασιστικά, ναζιστικά και σεξιστικά σύμβολα με τα οποία οι αστυνομικές δυνάμεις μολύνουν καθημερινά τον χώρο και την προσπάθεια αντικατάστασης του ελεύθερου και πράσινου χαρακτήρα της γειτονιάς με μαγαζιά παραγωγής κέρδους. Όπου η παρουσία του κόσμου σε αυτόν, θα ελέγχεται υπό όρους αγοράς.


Ο κόσμος της γειτονιάς, υπερασπιζόμενος τα ανοιχτά χαρακτηριστικά του λόφου, έχει αποτελέσει βασικό ανάχωμα στα σχέδια της οικονομικής εκμετάλλευσης του Στρέφη. Με αποτέλεσμα το κράτος να έχει κατασκευάσει ένα περιβάλλον τρομοκράτησης των κατοίκων, μέσω των αστυνομικών δυνάμεων (κυρίως ΜΑΤ και ΟΠΚΕ) που έχουν στρατοπεδεύσει στην περιοχή.


Απέναντι στις κατασταλτικές δυνάμεις που σημαδεύουν τον Λόφο Στρέφη με φασιστικά και σεξιστικά σύμβολα, η γειτονιά στήνει ανάχωμα: «Ο φασισμός είναι το δολοφονικό χέρι του κράτους και του κεφαλαίου. Φασίστες και μπάτσοι δε θα μπορείτε να κρυφτείτε ούτε στις τρύπες σας!, Ως εδώ!», γράφει στην ανακοίνωση της η Ανοιχτή Συνέλευση για την υπεράσπιση του Λόφου Στρέφη.


Ο κόσμος της γειτονιάς, θέλει να διασφαλιστεί ότι ο Στρέφης θα παραμείνει ανοιχτός. Μακριά από κερδοσκοπικούς μηχανισμούς και έλεγχο. Ένας λόφος ελεύθερος για κάθε δραστηριότητα, όπου η γειτονιά θα μπορεί να συνδιαμορφώνει τα χαρακτηριστικά του και να συνεχίσει να τον προσέχει, χωρίς να αλλοιώνει τον χαρακτήρα του. Να μη γίνει ο Λόφος Στρέφη ένας ακόμη χώρος παραγωγής κέρδους, προσβάσιμος μόνο σε όσους διαθέτουν τα χρήματα για να τον χρησιμοποιούν.

Pública

 encontrou é de 2009, quando a empresa foi registrada no Edifício Connect Towers, em salas ao lado da 2601, segundo a Receita Federal.


Na mesma sala do edifício comercial, estão registradas 90 empresas, incluindo a que tem Flávio Bolsonaro como sócio


Um dos sócios da empresa é Alexandre Caetano dos Reis, preso desde dezembro do ano passado por decisão do ministro André Mendonça do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF). Segundo a

PF

, Caetano atuou como contador de diversas empresas do “careca” em atividades de lavagem de dinheiro no esquema de fraudes do INSS.


A Voga tem uma empresa “filha”, chamada Voga Serviços, essa sim com sede na sala 2601 e aberta em 2021. O termo filha não é ao acaso: essa segunda Voga tem no registro Paula Batista dos Reis, a filha de Alessandra Batista Perdigão dos Reis, esposa de Alexandre.

 O email de Paula é usado tanto no cadastro da Voga Serviços, quanto da Voga Contabilidade aberta em 2009.


É neste endereço da sala 2601, além dos emails de Paula e da própria Voga que se conectam um emaranhado de 90 empresas nas quais os membros da família dos Reis se revezam nas sociedades.


É importante lembrar que a família dos Reis está ligada diretamente a Flávio Bolsonaro: é a irmã de Alexandre, Letícia Caetano dos Reis, que administra o escritório de advocacia de Flávio — o mesmo escritório

registrado

 na mansão milionária do senador, cuja compra foi

financiada

 pelo Banco de Brasília (BRB) e que teve o empréstimo quitado em tempo recorde.


Amigo de Flávio, Willer atua como advogado para empresa de contabilidade que liga empresas registradas na sala 2601


Willer Tomaz defende Voga em processo contra família dos Reis


A

Pública

 tentou visitar a sala da Voga na manhã desta sexta-feira, 23 de outubro. O acesso, contudo, foi barrado. A circulação no edifício foi limitada após a imprensa ter revelado o local.


Os 90 empreendimentos registrados na sala 2601 têm atividades variadas. A maioria é de consultoria e serviços administrativos (26), seguido por construção civil e incorporação imobiliária (19), comércio (16) e holdings (13).


Entrada da sala foi limitada após revelação de que Flávio Bolsonaro e careca do INSS têm escritório no mesmo local


A

Pública

 teve acesso a um processo trabalhista que reforça os laços entre as empresas da sala.

 É o mesmo processo

noticiado

 pelo Uol neste sábado, 24 de outubro. Na ação, um profissional afirma que trabalhou mais de dez anos para a Voga, até 2025. A pessoa afirma que a jornada de trabalho era extenuante e não remunerada.

E ainda que foi obrigada pela chefia a apagar dados que poderiam comprometer a empresa junto ao escândalo do INSS.

title: Geçgel ailesi zirveye tırmanırken Astor işçisi dipte
content:
Feridun Geçgel ve Enver Geçgel 

Kübra Kırımlı [email protected]

Ankara - Açığa çıkan fon vurgununda 3 yılda borsada yüzde 2.986 (yaklaşık 31 kat) oranında değer katlayan Astor Enerji’de işçiler bu dönem de ara zam alamadı. İşçilerin yalnızca eriyen ücretlerle boğuşmuyor, hedef baskısı, işsizlik tehdidi işçilerin üstünde kılıç gibi sallanıyor. İşçiler göçmen işçilerin çalıştırılmaya başladığı fabrikada “Dayanamazsanız gidin. Nepalliler kapıda bekliyor.” dediğini aktarıyor.

Astor Enerji’nin Temelli yerleşkesinde bulunan fabrikasında çalışan bir işçi çalışma koşullarını şöyle aktarıyor: “İşçiler mesai saatlerinde sürekli kamera ile takip ediliyor. Sürekli ayakta ve fazla mesai ile çalışıyoruz. İş dışında kalan zaman uyumaya zor yetiyor. ‘Hedef var.’ lafı hiç bitmiyor. Her gün milyonluk ürünler çıkıyor. İşçiden hep daha fazlası isteniyor. Tuvalete gitmen bile dert. Hata olduğunda ya da bir hedef yetişmediğinde, ‘3-4 defa tuvalete gitmişsiniz.’ diyorlar.”

Aynı yerleşkede çalışan bir Astor işçisinin eşiyle denk geliyoruz bu kez. 2024 yılı itibariyle artan masraflar, enflasyon, çocukların eğitim ihtiyaçları derken kendisi de Kazan bölgesinde bir fabrikada işe başladığını anlatıyor: “Önceden bir şekliyle idare ediyorduk. Şimdi iki kişi çalışıyoruz yine de yetmiyor. Eşim çocukların yüzünü göremez oldu. Yetiştirebilmek için sürekli işte. Çocuklar birbirine bakıyor. Ana babalık yapamaz duruma geleceğiz. Çocuklar okul masrafları, harçlıkları, kıyafeti, mutfağı derken mahcup olmamak için elimizden ne geliyorsa yapıyoruz. Astor’un fon işinde ne kadar paralar kazandığını görünce eşimle birbirimize bakıp güldük. Bizim hiç mi değerimiz yok? Ne paralar kazanmışlar, milyon dolarlar. Bizim derdimiz de çalış, çabala çocuklarına mahçup olma. Hayal edemediğimiz paralar… Eşim fabrikada Astor’un borsadan para kazandırdığını duyunca, ‘Paramız olsa biz de girerdik’ demişti. Onlardan bize düşer mi? Bakın onlara hiçbir şey olmadı. Biz ‘kış geliyor çocuklara, kendimize nasıl bot, mont alırız’ diye onu düşünüyoruz. Elde kalanı bırakın nasıl ekside olmayız derdindeyiz.”

Astor, Hidromek, Mitaş gibi Ankara’nın birçok fabrikasında çoğunluğunu Nepallilerin oluşturduğu göçmen işçiler çalışıyor. Üretimin yoğunluğuna göre çalışma saat ve günlerinin esnek bırakıldığı, kimisinin fabrikalarda kimisinin 8 kişinin kaldığı odalarda barındığı göçmen işçiler patronlar için ucuzunda ucuzu işçi anlamına geliyor. Ücret düşük, fazla mesai ücreti eksik, hak ve tazminat tanınmıyor. Astor işçileri Nepalli işçi sayısının 1000’e yaklaşacağını söylüyor.

Astor’un Mekanik fabrikasında çalışan bir işçi “Nepalli işçileri bize karşı tehdit olarak kullanıyorlar. Adamlar açlığın içinden çıkıp ailelerine para yollamak için buralara kadar gelmişler. Onlara istediklerini yaptırıyorlar. Çok kötü koşullardalar. Üstüne de bize karşı bir nevi koz olarak kullanıyorlar. Sesimiz çıkmasın, ezilmemizden başka istedikleri yok. İşçi ucuz olsun da gerisi hep onun olsun” diye ifade ediyor.

Konuştuğumuz bir Astor işçisi “Hükümet onlar ne isterse onu yapıyor. Onlar için var. Ucuz işçi mi? Kıtalar arasından bulup getiriyorlar. Bize ne yapıyorlar? Nepalliler gelecek deyip işten çıkarılanlar oldu. Kalan da üç kuruşa çalışsın. Kimse bunları yaşamamalı. Kimse işinden çıkarılmamalı. Hakkımızı aramalıyız.”

İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı fon vurgunu soruşturmasında TMSF’nin “gönüllü iade” hesabına 5 milyar lira ödediği iddia edilen Astor Enerji’nin ana hissedarları Feridun Geçgel ve Enver Geçgel hakkında 26 Eylül’de uygulanan mal varlığı tedbirleri ile dondurma kararını kaldırdı. Geçgel kardeşlerin 5 milyar lirayı gönüllü olarak iade ettiği yönünde iddialar bulunsa da söz konusu tutara ilişkin resmi bir doğrulama bulunmuyor.

1983’te Transtek Transformatör adıyla kurulan şirketi 2005 yılında 3 milyon dolara satın alan Geçgel ailesinden Feridun Geçgel, 2018 seçimleri için AKP Urfa milletvekili aday adayı olurken, “Hizmet için varım. AK Parti’nin bir neferi olarak çalışmaya söz veriyorum” demişti. Astor Enerji 2023 yılının başlarında borsaya açılmıştı. ABD merkezli Forbes’un gerçek zamanlı milyarderler listesine göre Geçgel’in serveti 4 Mayıs itibarıyla 4.1 milyar dolara çıkmıştı. Mart ayının başında Feridun Geçgel’in serveti 2.6 milyar dolar seviyesindeydi. Feridun ve Enver Geçgel’in ASTOR’daki toplam payı yüzde 57.25.

Astor Enerji, 11-13 Ocak 2023 tarihlerinde pay başına 12.50 TL sabit fiyatla halka arz edildi. Hisse, 2 Haziran 2026 tarihinde tarihi zirvesini görerek 385.8 TL seviyesine …

title: Yarım milyon İtalyan öğrenci sokağa çıktı: Daha fazla sınıf, daha az bomba
content:
Scintilla Gazetesi Editörü Vik Grandi

İtalya şu anda yoğun bir toplumsal istikrarsızlık ve harekete geçme dönemi yaşıyor. Her gün gösteriler, grevler ve yol kesmeler yaşanıyor. Bu durum, artan yaşam maliyetlerine karşı protestolarla kendiliğinden başladı. 16 ve 17 Ekim’de ise birçok şehirde büyük gösterilere dönüştü.

En başta neden, benzin fiyatları ve diğer hoşnutsuzluklardı. Protestolar daha sonra iş güvencesizliği, düşük ücretler, sosyal harcamalardaki kesintiler, silahlanmanın artması gibi daha geniş kapsamlı taleplerle birleşti.

Ana akım medya, başlangıçta bu toplumsal harekete tamamen göz yumdu, ardından da ‘suç’ olarak nitelendirdi. Sokak protestolarının gerçek nedenleri yerine polisle yaşanan çatışmalara öncelik verdi.

Bunun başlıca nedenleri, ülkenin ekonomik ve siyasi durumu.

İtalya’da ekonomi durgun seyrini sürdürüyor. 2026 yılında GSYİH’nin yüzde 0.9 büyümesi bekleniyor. İşçilerin büyük bir kısmı, ailelerini geçindirmek için yetersiz kalan ücretler nedeniyle ağırlaşan iş güvensizliğinden mustarip. Yüksek enflasyon, ücretlerin satın alma gücünü daha da azalttı. İşten çıkarmalarla birlikte yaşanan sanayi krizi; tarım, ulaştırma ve turizm sektörlerindeki krizlerle daha da ağırlaşıyor.

Benzin fiyatı litre başına 2 avroyu aşarken, dizel fiyatı 3 avroya ulaştı. Şu anda 2.3 avro seviyesinde seyrediyor. Bazı günlük tüketim mallarında (kahve, yağ, domates, pirinç) yüzde 40’ı aşan fiyat artışları görüldü.

Meloni Hükümeti, 1990’ların başından beri durgunlaşan ücretleri korumak için hiçbir adım atmadı. Sonuç olarak, tüketim azalıyor ve yoksulluk artıyor.

En kötüsü ise kış faturalarıyla gelecek. Buna ek olarak konut, sağlık ve sosyal yardım krizleri ile çevresel tahribat da söz konusu.

Üstelik bir başka kemer sıkma ve silahlanma bütçesi hazırlanıyor. 2026 yılı askeri harcamaları 35 milyar avroya yükseldi. Meloni, Trump ile askeri harcamaların GSYİH’nin yüzde 5’i düzeyinde tutulması konusunda varılan anlaşmayı sürdürmek için daha fazla kesinti ya da yeni vergiler öngörüyor.

Yaklaşık 6 milyon kişi mutlak yoksulluk içinde yaşıyor (Nüfusun yaklaşık yüzde 10’u); ekonomik imkansızlıklar nedeniyle sağlık hizmetlerinden bile mahrum kalıyorlar. Şu anda yüzde 18.9 olan genç işsizliği artıyor.

Faiz harcamaları artmaya devam ediyor, 2027’de yıllık 103 milyar avro olacak.

Made in Italy” Bakanlığında, çoğunlukla metal iş kolunu ilgilendiren yaklaşık seksen görüşme yapıldı. Kapanma riskiyle karşı karşıya olan eski ILVA Çelik Fabrikası ve 1250 kişinin işten çıkarılmasının söz konusu olduğu Electrolux Fabrikası vakası bu durumun simgesel örnekleridir.*****

Bu arada, genel enflasyon yüzde 4’ün üzerinde, yakıt enflasyonuysa ortalama yüzde 15. Henüz yenilenen sözleşmelere rağmen, satın alma gücü 2021’e kıyasla yüzde 10 daha düşük. Emeklilik artık 67 yaş ve üzerinde mümkün.

Konut giderleri 2000’den 2025’e kadar yüzde 100’ün üzerinde arttı.

Sınıflar arasındaki uçurum giderek genişliyor. Süper zenginler, yani nüfusun yüzde 5’i, ulusal servetin yaklaşık yüzde 50’sine sahip.

Bu yetmezmiş gibi, hükümet sağlık, eğitim, sosyal hizmetler ile engelliler ve yoksullar için yönelik programlara ayrılan bütçeyi kesmeye devam ediyor buna karşın askeri harcamalar artmayı sürdürüyor.

Meloni Hükümeti, görev süresi boyunca sekiz “Güvenlik Kararnamesi” ile grev yapan işçilere yönelik baskıyı artırdı. İş yerlerinde her gün can kayıpları yaşanıyor. Bu yıl toplam 1074 ölüm kaydedildi; yani günde dört ölüm.

Meloni, Salvini ve Tajani’den oluşan gerici hükümet ise iş kazası durumunda “işverenler” için bir tür cezai koruma kalkanı getirerek dokunulmazlık mekanizmaları oluşturmayı düşünüyor; bu sayede geçerli belgeleri olan patronlara önemli ölçüde hafifletme tanınacak.

Ülkenin durumu böyle. Peki bugün harekete geçen başlıca kesimler kimler?

Birincisi, eğitim bütçesindeki kesintilere, yüksek kiralara karşı gösteriler ve okul işgalleri gerçekleştiren öğrenciler. 16 Ekim’de yarım milyondan fazla öğrenci sokaklara döküldü ve 30 Ekim’de gerçekleşecek genel grevle yeniden harekete geçmeye hazırlar.

Çoğu reşit olmayan yaklaşık 350 genç gözaltına alındı. Fransız öğrenciler, özellikle kuzey İtalya’da büyük yankı uyandırdı. Birçok şehirde, “Savaşa değil, okullara para” ve “Daha fazla sınıf, daha az bomba” gibi sloganlarla sokaklara döküldüler. Çeşitli gösterilerde öğrenciler Filistin halkıyla dayanışma içinde olduklarını da ifade etti.

author: Unknown
title: Dünya dışı yaşamı ararken neler öğrendik?
content:
Dr. Öğr. Üyesi M. Taşkın Çay [email protected]

Eylül 2026’da yayımlanan bir araştırmada, Dünya’dan yaklaşık 63 ışık yılı uzaklıktaki β Pictoris b gezegeninden radyo yayımı saptandığı bildirildi. Bazı medya başlıklarının da etkisiyle haber, tanıdık bir soruyu yeniden akla getirdi: Uzaylılardan mesaj mı alıyoruz? Oysa araştırmanın konusu bir uygarlığın gönderdiği mesaj değildi. Bilim insanları, Jüpiter’de de gözlenen kutup ışıklarına benzer süreçlerin üretebileceği doğal radyo yayımını inceleyerek gezegenin manyetik alanına ilişkin bilgiler elde etmeye çalışıyordu. Çalışmanın sonuçları doğrulanırsa, ötegezegenlerin manyetik alanlarını araştırmada önemli bir adım atılmış olacak.

Bu tür haberlerde başlıklar zaman zaman bir “uzaylı mesajı” veya “yaşam keşfi” beklentisi uyandırabiliyor. Geçmişte Venüs atmosferindeki fosfin ve daha yakın zamanda K2-18b’nin atmosferine ilişkin haberlerde de benzer bir durumla karşılaştık. Gözlemle yorum, olasılıkla kanıt arasındaki sınırlar, bilimsel çalışmaların kamuoyuna aktarılması sırasında zaman zaman belirsizleşebiliyor. Bununla birlikte, dünya dışı yaşam konusundaki spekülasyonlar yeni olmadığı gibi yalnızca medyaya özgü de değil.

1950-60’lı yıllarda yaşamın kökeni ve dünya dışı yaşam araştırmalarının deneysel ve gözlemsel olanakları sınırlı, eldeki veriler oldukça azdı. Bilimin henüz açıklayamadığı konular, sonraki yıllarda Erich von Däniken’in antik astronot iddialarında olduğu gibi, sözde bilimsel anlatılara da geniş bir alan açıyordu. Bu anlatılarda bilimsel bulgular kimi zaman spekülatif iddiaları desteklemek için kullanılırken, bilim insanları da gerçekleri gizlemekle veya dünya dışı yaşam olasılığını ciddiye almamakla suçlanabiliyordu. Oysa bilimsel çalışmaların yavaş ama temkinli ilerleyişi, bilim insanlarının bu sorulara ilgisiz olduğu anlamına gelmiyordu.

Nitekim 1960’ta Frank Drake’in yürüttüğü Ozma projesi, dünya dışı zeka arayışının (SETI) ilk sistematik radyo gözlemlerinden biriydi. 1967’de ise Jocelyn Bell Burnell’in keşfettiği son derece düzenli radyo atımlarının dünya dışı bir uygarlıktan kaynaklanabileceği olasılığı da değerlendirilmişti. Ancak ilerleyen gözlemler, bunların pulsar adı verilen, hızla dönen nötron yıldızlarından kaynaklandığını ortaya koydu. Bu olay, sıra dışı bir hipotezin nasıl sınandığının öğretici bir örneğidir. Bilim ile spekülasyonu ayıran şey, alışılmadık olasılıkları düşünmek değil, onları kanıtlar karşısında sınamaya ve gerektiğinde terk etmeye hazır olmaktır.

Aradan geçen yıllarda değişen yalnızca gözlem araçlarımızın duyarlılığı veya topladığımız verilerin miktarı olmadı. Yaşamın kimyasal ve biyolojik temellerine ilişkin bilgilerimiz arttı; uzay araştırmaları, gezegen bilimleri, astronomi ve biyoloji arasında yeni bağlantılar kuruldu. Bir zamanlar hakkında ancak varsayımlarda bulunabildiğimiz uzak gezegenleri keşfedebilir, atmosferlerini inceleyebilir ve yaşam için uygun koşullara sahip olup olmadıklarını araştırabilir hale geldik. Dünya dışı yaşam sorusunun giderek daha fazla yönü, gözlem ve deneylerle araştırılabilir hale geldi.

Astrobiyoloji, bu gelişmelerin bir araya geldiği disiplinler arası bir bilim alanı. Yalnızca başka dünyalarda canlı aramaktan ibaret değil; yaşamın nasıl ortaya çıktığını, hangi koşullarda varlığını sürdürdüğünü, nasıl evrimleştiğini ve evrende ne kadar yaygın olabileceğini de araştırıyor. Bunun için başlıca referansımız Dünya’daki yaşam. Bildiğimiz bütün canlılar ortak bir evrimsel geçmişi paylaşıyor. Mikroorganizmaların yüksek basınç, aşırı sıcaklık veya tuzluluk gibi koşullara uyum sağlayabildiğini biliyoruz. Bu çeşitlilik, başka dünyalarda yaşam arayabileceğimiz ortamları düşünürken bize yol gösteriyor. Ancak temel sorularımızın bir bölümü hâlâ yanıtsız. Yaşamın cansız kimyasal sistemlerden hangi süreçlerle ortaya çıktığını henüz bilmiyoruz. Üstelik elimizde yalnızca tek bir yaşam örneği, Dünya biyosferi var. Bu nedenle yaşamın Dünya’dakinden farklı biçimlerde ortaya çıkıp çıkamayacağını ve evrende ne kadar yaygın olduğunu da henüz bilmiyoruz.

Bütün bu bilinmeyenlere rağmen, Dünya’daki yaşamdan öğrendiklerimiz sayesinde başka dünyalarda nerelere bakacağımızı daha iyi biliyoruz. Mars’ın geçmişte sıvı su barındırdığını gösteren kanıtlarımız var. Jüpiter’in Europa ve Satürn’ün Enceladus uydularındaki buz altı okyanuslarının yaşam için uygun koşullar sağlayıp sağlayamayacağını araştırıyoruz. Sıvı su kadar, enerji kaynakları ve uygun kimyasal maddelerin varlığı da önemli. Güneş Sistemi’nin ötesinde ise …

title: Arnavutluk’ta farklı kesimler ortak taleplerle sokakta: ‘Yoksulluk, yolsuzluk ve yağmaya karşı mücadeleye’
content:
Arnavutluk’ta 13 Ekim 2026’da yüzlerce üniversite öğrencisinin Tiran’daki Eğitim Bakanlığı önünde toplanmasıyla başlayan eylemler hızla kitleselleşti. “Arnavutluk satılık değildir”, “Rama istifa”, “Halk yolsuzluğa ve yoksulluğa karşı” sloganlarıyla sokaklara çıkan öğrenciler, işçiler, kamu emekçileri ve birçok kesim mücadelede ısrarcı olduğunu söylüyor.

Arnavutluk’ta protestoları örgütleyen örgütlerden Qemal Stafa Komünist Gençlik Örgütü Sekreteri Alban Çelaj, Arnavutluk’ta son durumu Evrensel’e anlattı.

2026 yazı boyunca Tiran’da “Flamingo Hareketi” olarak bilinen protestolara tanık olduk. 13 Ekim’den bu yana çeşitli kesimler yeniden sokaklarda. Protestolar nasıl yeniden kıvılcımlandı?

Bu protestolar yazın başlangıçta, Donald Trump’ın damadı Jared Kushner ile kızı Ivanka Trump’ın dahil olduğu, milyarlarca dolarlık bir turistik projeye karşıydı.

Arnavutlar bunu toprakların yabancı çıkarlara satılması olarak gördü. Bu projede koruma altındaki alanların metrekare başına 1 avro bedelle satıldığı iddia ediliyordu. Bu süreç, kamu arazilerinin sahtecilik iddialarıyla ele geçirilmesi, özel mülklere el konulması ve devredilmesiyle ortaya çıktı.

Kamu malına el koyan oligarkların ortaya çıktığı bir ülkede, bu durum protestoları ateşledi. Protestolar günlerce gayet barışçıl biçimde sürdü, ancak hiçbir şey değişmedi. Ülkenin Başbakanı, kararlaştırdığı şeyi uygulamaya devam edeceğini, AB üyeliği yolunda ilerleme sağlayanın yalnızca kendisi olduğunu ve iktidara gelecek başka birinin ülkeyi bu konuda geriye götüreceğini bile söyledi.

Bu da son günlerde öğrencilerin kitlesel biçimde sokaklara çıkmasına yol açtı, protestolar giderek sertleşti ve polisle yoğun çatışmalar yaşandı. Görevi özellikle silahlı tehditlerin etkisiz hale getirilmesi olmasına rağmen, polise destek olması için RENEA özel kuvvetleri de görevlendirildi.

Protestocular, Vodafone Albania, One Albania ve Iute Credit gibi büyük şirketleri hedef aldı. Bu şirketler, finansal duruma ilişkin yeterli güvence olmadan kredi vermeleriyle ve çok yüksek komisyonlar almalarıyla biliniyor.

Sokaklarda en çok hangi kesimleri görüyoruz? Hangi talepler öne çıkıyor?

Bu hareket Z kuşağı protestoları olarak tanındı. Olaylara katılan gençler kararlı ve korkusuz. Ancak önemli olan, gösterilerin siyasi yelpazenin her kesiminden insanları bir araya getirmesi. Bununla birlikte sol görüşlü katılımcılar ağırlıkta. Bileşen de çeşitli, en büyük bölümünü orta gelirli veya yoksul kesimler oluşturuyor. Protestolar, bizzat Edi Rama’nın da kabul ettiği gibi, geniş bir kamu çalışanı kesimden ve Sosyalist Parti üyelerinden de önemli destek görüyor.

Talepleri çok net. Başbakanın istifasını ve hukuki olarak hesap vermesini istiyorlar. Ayrıca Sali Berisha gibi şu anda muhalefette olan eski siyasi liderlerin, yolsuzluk nedeniyle soruşturulan Belinda Balluku gibi bakanlarla birlikte hesap vermesini talep ediyorlar. Yoksulluk ve yolsuzluğa karşı mücadele son eylemlerde daha da öne çıkıyor.

Bu protestolar konusunda bana umut veren şey, göstericiler arasındaki yaygın sistem karşıtlığı. Ancak sistemin bütününe yönelik bu muhalefetin, onun yerini nasıl bir alternatifin alması gerektiğine ve bu değişimin nasıl sağlanacağına dair bir kavrayışa dönüşüp dönüşmeyeceği henüz belli değil.

Yazın gerçekleşen protestolarla şimdiki arasında somut farklar var mı? Sürecin ilerleyişini nasıl yorumlarsınız?

Farklar açık: İlk protestolarda göstericilerin hükümete yönelttiği talepler vardı, şimdiki protestolarda ise bu talepleri ne pahasına olursa olsun elde edeceklerini dile getiriyorlar.

Protestolar daha şiddetli hale geldi, ancak bu şiddeti güvenlik güçleri tetikledi.

Protestocular talep ettikleri şeyi elde etmekte kararlı, hükümet ise geri adım atmayı reddediyor. Bu da daha kritik bir tablo ortaya koyuyor. Mevcut yönetim seçimleri kazandığı gerekçesiyle, başlattığı yoldan devam edeceğini söylüyor.

Açıkça anlaşılması gereken şey, bu hareketin protestolardan önce de pozisyonlarını tutarlı biçimde koruyan tek bir milletvekili dışında, parlamentoda temsil edilmediğidir. Sokakta eylem yapanlar parlamentoyu bir bütün olarak reddediyor. Parlamentoda eskisi gibi oligarşik çıkarları gözeten yasalar oylanıyor ve destekleniyor.

Protestocular, taleplerine yönelik olumlu herhangi bir şeyin parlamentodan çıkmayacağının farkında.

Avrupa genelinde bir eylemlilik dalgası var. Arnavutluk dahil Avrupa’da aynı dönemde farklı sloganlarla sokaklara çıkılmasının bir anlamı var mı?

author: labor4pal
title: Pressure Campaigns: How Boycotts and Direct Action Are Challenging Corporate Power [Labor for Palestine-LA.OC.IE, Entertainment Labor for Palestine] (LAProgressive)
content:
At the 2026 Left Coast Forum, organizers behind the Home Depot, Hilton, Spotify, Citizens Bank, and Hollywood boycott campaigns shared how economic pressure, coalition building, and strategic disruption can force powerful institutions to respond.

What happens when activists stop asking corporations to do the right thing and start making it expensive for them to do the wrong thing?

That question was at the heart of “Pressure Campaigns: The Power of Boycotts and Direct Action,” a panel at the fourth annual Left Coast Forum, held October 2–4, 2026, at Cal State Los Angeles.

Moderated by MaryLinda Moss, artist, activist, and founding member of NELA Alliance for Democracy, the discussion brought together Miriam Arghandiwal, an organizer with the Boycott Home Depot Coalition and Entertainment Labor for Palestine; Chris Abrahamsen, co-founder of Grassroots Activist International Association and regional director of ICEBreakers; and Robby Kumar, a former investment banker and congressional staffer working with De-ICE Citizens Bank and No Camps California.

Their campaigns target different industries, but share a central premise: Corporations respond to financial incentives, public scrutiny, and the possibility of losing customers, investors, and business relationships.

The panelists described how ordinary people can use those vulnerabilities to challenge institutions with vastly greater financial and political resources.

Arghandiwal described the Boycott Home Depot Coalition’s campaign against the retailer over immigration enforcement raids targeting day laborers in its parking lots.

The boycott, initiated by Unión del Barrio, calls on Home Depot to publicly condemn ICE operations, prevent immigration enforcement activities on its properties where legally possible, provide safe hiring areas for day laborers, compensate affected families, and remove surveillance equipment and devices intended to discourage people from gathering.

Arghandiwal said organizers have documented more than 700 people taken into custody in connection with Home Depot locations across Southern California.

But she emphasized that pressure campaigns must protect the very people they are intended to support.

Demonstrations at stores where day laborers gather can inadvertently attract additional law enforcement, putting vulnerable workers at greater risk.

The coalition therefore developed guidelines requiring organizers to consult day laborers before staging protests and, when appropriate, conduct demonstrations at locations or times that minimize those risks.

The campaign has also pursued divestment. Arghandiwal reported that organizers helped secure the withdrawal of $20 million in Illinois investment funds from Home Depot and a smaller divestment commitment in West Hollywood.

These actions illustrate how consumer boycotts can extend into public investment decisions, increasing pressure beyond individual purchasing choices.

Arghandiwal also discussed Entertainment Labor for Palestine, which organizes in support of the Palestinian-led Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions (BDS) movement.

Unlike conventional consumer campaigns, Hollywood pressure campaigns often focus on cultural influence, public reputation, and accountability within the entertainment industry.

Organizers have demonstrated at the Academy Awards, protested film premieres, and challenged entertainment companies over their treatment of artists who publicly support Palestinian rights.

Arghandiwal cited protests surrounding Scream 7, following the firing of actress Melissa Barrera over social media statements concerning Gaza.

She described efforts to sustain public attention throughout the film’s promotional campaign, including demonstrations at its premiere.

Entertainment Labor for Palestine also participated in protests surrounding Disney productions, including Captain America: Brave New World and Snow White.

For Arghandiwal, success is not measured exclusively in immediate box-office losses.

Changing what studios, executives, and performers consider reputationally acceptable can influence future decisions even when the financial consequences are difficult to calculate.

Her broader argument was that sustained public resistance can make controversial corporate decisions harder to normalize.

Chris Abrahamsen offered one of the panel’s clearest examples of a campaign with a specific corporate demand and a reported measurable outcome.

title: Δεν είναι ευπρόσδεκτος. Πουθενά. Αλληλεγγύη στην επιζήσασα
content:
Δεν είναι ευπρόσδεκτος. Πουθενά. Αλληλεγγύη στην επιζήσασα


Ως πρωτοβουλία αλληλέγγυων εργαζομένων στο χώρο της εικόνας δηλώνουμε απερίφραστα ότι δεν υπάρχει καμία ανοχή απέναντι σε κακοποιητικές συμπεριφορές και σεξιστικές πρακτικές στο κίνημα, στις καταλήψεις, στις συνελεύσεις, στους εργασιακούς χώρους και στο δρόμο.


Ξεκαθαρίζουμε ότι δεν χωράνε κακοποιητές στον κλάδο μας και απαιτούμε την άμεση και οριστική αποπομπή του καταγγελλόμενου από κάθε επαγγελματικό χώρο, σώμα και όργανο.


Δεν είναι ευπρόσδεκτος. Πουθενά.


Την ώρα που η προσοχή μας είναι στραμμένη απέναντι στους εξωτερικούς και δομικούς εχθρούς (κράτος, καταστολή, φασισμός, πατριαρχία, ρατσισμός, συνθήκες επιβίωσης, εργασίας κα.), η διάρρηξη της εμπιστοσύνης από τα μέσα ακυρώνει την ίδια την υπόσταση του “οικείου χώρου”, αμφισβητεί την “συντροφικότητα” και επαναφέρει αυτό που διατυπώνει με σαφήνεια το σύνθημα “οι βιαστές έχουν τα κλειδιά του σπιτιού μας”.


Οι προοδευτικές ιδέες, ταυτότητες όπως του αντισεξιστή και του αντιφασίστα δεν τις κουβαλάμε απριόρι, διαμορφώνονται μέσα από καθημερινές μικρές μάχες για να αποβάλουμε κυρίαρχες πρακτικές του καπιταλισμού και της πατριαρχίας.


Η πρόσφατη σοκαριστική καταγγελία για βιασμό και κακοποίηση είναι η αποτύπωση μιας πρακτικής που ο καταγγελλόμενος προέβη εκμεταλλευόμενος την ταυτότητα ενός προοδευτικού ατόμου αλλά και την επαγγελματική του θέση.


Πρόκειται για μια βαρύτατη κατάχρηση εξουσίας που πλήττει βάναυσα την αξιοπρέπεια των εργαζομένων και την ασφάλεια μας είτε ως

πολιτικά υποκείμενα

 είτε ως εργαζόμενες στον χώρο της πληροφορίας – αντιπληροφοριας.


Θεωρούμε πως αυτό δεν πρέπει να περάσει έτσι και να ξεχαστεί. Απαιτείται συνεχής ενημέρωση, επιμόρφωση από φορείς που δραστηριοποιούνται στο πεδίο κι έχουν εμπειρία, αναστοχαστικές διεργασίες ειδικά από τις αρρενωπότητες του κλάδου και του κινήματος για εξουσιαστικές συμπεριφορές που αναπαράγονται μεταξύ μας, δημιουργία χώρων για την ενδυνάμωση των πιο ευάλωτων κα μη προνομοιούχων φωνών.


Σωματεία, συλλογικότητες οφείλουν να αναλάβουν πρωτοβουλίες για να μετατραπούν σε ασφαλείς χώρους για θηλυκότητες και λοατκι άτομα.


Στον κλάδο των ΜΜΕ και στο κίνημα σίγουρα υπάρχουν πολλά παρόμοια περιστατικά όπως αυτό που καταγγέλθηκε και χρειάζεται μια πρωτοβουλία έτσι ώστε να δημιουργηθεί το κατάλληλο περιβάλλον εμπιστοσύνης και υποστήριξης για να εκφραστούν. Το άνοιγμα των σωματείων στα επισφαλώς εργαζόμενα άτομα είναι αναγκαίο για τη συγκρότηση ενός τέτοιου περιβάλλοντος.


Να ανατρέψουμε την παρωχημένη ψευδαίσθηση ότι ο ρεπόρτερ οφείλει να είναι ένας αποστασιοποιημένος, ψυχρός παρατηρητής. Είμαστε κομμάτι της κοινωνίας και διεκδικούμε ένα επάγγελμα-λειτούργημα, βασισμένο στην αλληλεγγύη, τη συμπερίληψη,τη συλλογική συνείδηση,μακριά από λογικές κανιβαλιστικού ανταγωνισμού.


Μια τέτοια καταγγελία δοκιμάζει τις αντοχές της επιζήσασας αλλά και του περιβάλλοντος της. Στεκόμαστε αλληλέγγυοι σε όλα όσα την στηρίζουν.


Στηρίζουμε το κάλεσμα για συγκέντρωση και πορεία,
